tei:div.tei:p: rtsom sgrig u yon lhan khang /kru'u rin/ dgra 'dul/kru'u rin gzhon pa/ gdugs dkar tshe ring /gartso sgrig pa/ bsod nams tshe ring /gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ rta mgrin skyabs/ rin chen don grub/sgrol ma rgya ma31/rtsom sgrig u yon/ rdo rje tshe ring / tshe ring thar/ gsang bdagapad+ma rdo rje/ blo gros/ bde skyid sgrol ma/bkra rgyal/ zla ba tshe ring / dbang phyug mtsho mo/lis zha'o kru'u/ lha byams rgyal/

sngon 'gro'i gtam/legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs la 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro'i gtam/gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing ri klung bar khams thams cad rnam par dag pa'i bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/bod mi rigs rnams lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i snga rol nas gzhis chags shing 'tsho gzhes gnang ste 'od stong rnam par bkra ba'i lo rgyus bskrun yod la/ khyad par du bod rig pa zhes mtshan snyan 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon la mngon par ldir ba'i rig gnas kyi bang mdzod zad mtha' med pa zhig nga tsho phyi rabs pa'i bgo skal du stsal cing / gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i mkhas dbang mang po rim par byon nas dus rabs so sor rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos sna tshogs shig rtsom gnang mdzad pa dang /bod rang gi khyad chos dang yongs su mthun pa'i legs bshad ces pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa gsar ba zhig gsar skrun bgyis pa des/1

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rtsom rig spyi'i rigs sam lus kyi rnam pa je mang je tshang du btang ba yin pas/ rtsom rig gi gzhung lugs thad bla na med pa'i mdzad rjes shig dang rmad du byung ba'i dge mtshan zhig bskrun par snang ngo / /skabs bab kyi brjod bya legs bshad ces pa'i tha snyad de don gang la 'jug ce na/ yongs grags su sgra yangs 'jug dang dog 'jug gnyis su dbye ste brjod par bya dgos te/ tshig sbyor snyan zhing don gyis phyug pa'i gsung rnam dag dang bstan bcos mtha' dag la legs bshad ces pa sgra yangs 'jug gi don yin la/ rtsom stangs nges can zhig gis 'ching ba'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig la legs bshad ces pa sgra dog 'jug gi don yin no/ /de ltar 'jug pa'i don gnyis ni phan tshun 'gal bar mi 'gyur te/ de gnyis bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel ba yod pa'i phyir/ sgra dog 'jug gi don ldan pa'i brtsams chos yin na yangs 'jug gi don gyi rang bzhin ldan pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /yin na'ang sgra yangs 'jug gi don ldan pa'i brtsams chos yin na dog 'jug gi don gyi bdag 2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/nyid ldan pa'i brtsams chos yin pa'i nges pa ma mchis so/ /'dir brjod pa'i legs bshad ni sgra dog 'jug gi don yin te/ rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig la brjod pa yin no/ /'di lta bu'i legs bshad ces pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa der khyad chos ci zhig ldan zhe na/ de la 'di ltar brtag dgos te/brjod bya sna mang phun tshogs la dpe don legs par sbyar te tshigs bcad kyi rnam pas ston pa'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos la legs bshad ces pa'i tha snyad btags pa yin/ de'i brjod bya sna mang phun tshogs yin par smra bar rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsom pa pos bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab dang bstun nas chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ chos lugs/ slob gso/ dmag don la sogs pa chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya dngos mang po la legs par dpyad nas/chos lugs kyi bsam blo/ srid 'dzin gyi thabs lam/ mkhas blun gyi spyod pa/ blang dor gyi tshad gzhi bcas lkog gyur gyi don mang po la rang nyid kyi lta stangs dang bzhed tshul gsal bar ston pa'i brtsams chos yin pa'i phyir ro/ /legs bshad bstan bcos de sgyu 3

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rtsal gyi rang bzhin yongs su gtams pa'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos yin pa'i dbang gis/ de'i rjod byed kyi tshig dang ston byed kyi thabs la brtsams chos gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i khyad chos mang po yod/ mdor sdud na/ legs bshad kyi brtsams chos mtha' dag tshigs bcad kyi rnam pa yin pa dang gcig sho lo ka gcig las tshig rkang gnyis dpe dang tshig rkang gnyis don snga phyi nges med du legs par sbyar te bstan bya rdzogs par ston pa dang gnyis/gsal byed kyi dpe skye bo mkhas blun thams cad kyis nyams su myong ba'am thos pa las byung ba'i yun ring du 'dris pa'i bya dngos yin pa dang gsum/ tshig sbyor bde zhing go sla ba/ dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe'i rang bzhin ldan pa/ skye bo kun gyis dka' tshegs med par bde blag tu 'jug nus pa dang bzhi/ tshig snyan zhing ro nyams ldan pa/ skye bo mchog dman kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa dang lnga'i khyad par gyi yon tan ldan pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i yon tan lnga ldan gyi rtsom rig gi rnam pa de/ bod mi rigs kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus thog gal che zhing 'phang mtho ba'i go sa yod par mkhas pa 4

sngon 'gro'i gtam/rnams kyis yang yang du bsngags pa'o/ / legs bshad rtsom rig de bod la ji ltar byung ba dang ji ltar 'phel ba'i lo rgyus thad cung tsam dpyad na/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang tun hong yig cha nas zhal gdams zhes pa dpe don sbyar nas bslab bya'i rang bzhin yod pa'i brtsams chos byung / de dag ni legs bshad rtsom rig gi sa bon lta bur gyur te/ rtsom rig gi rnam pa de bod yul du thog mar gzhi chags so/ /de rjes spyi lo dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya parnyi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis zhal gdams de dag gi srol rgyun gzhir byas shing / 'phags yul gyi rtsom rig skye bo gso thigs sogs brtsams chos 'ga' dper byas nas legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba'i sho lo ka bzhi brgya lhag yod pa'i brtsams chos mdzad de/ legs bshad rtsom rig gi rnam gzhag gtan la phab/ dus rabs bcu drug par paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas sa skya legs bshad kyi rnam gzhag dang cha yongs su mtshungs pa'i mkhas blun brtag pa'i bstan bcos dge ldan legs 5

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bshad pad+ma dkar po'i chun po zhes bya ba sho lo ka brgya lhag ldan pa'i bstan bcos mdzad de/ legs bshad rtsom rig gi rnam pa de je rgyas je legs su btang / de rjes dus rabs bco brgyad par gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes gong smras legs bshad bstan bcos dag ma dper byas nas chu'i bstan bcos dang shing gi bstan bcos zhes bsdoms pas sho lo ka nyis brgya lhag yod pa'i bstan bcos gnyis mdzad pa dang / dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mkhas dbang dkyil zur blo bzang sbyin pas gung thang pa'i chu shing bstan bcos kyi rtsom stangs dang yongs su mthun pa'i lugs zung ba dan g.yo ba'i legs bshad rlung gi bstan bcos zhes bya ba sho lo ka drug cu lhag yod pa'i bstan bcos dang / 'jig rten mi chos dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya gsal bar ston pa'i legs bshad zla ba'i bstan bcos zhes pa sho lo ka sum cu lhag yod pa'i bstan bcos sogs du ma mdzad/ brtsams chos de dag ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dpe chos can gcig gi steng du de'i skyon yon brtags shing don dang sbyar nas bslab bya'i tshul gyis ston pa yin 6

shā —sgo blo — :sngozuga'o/11:re ba/tamazug/pas legs bshad kyi rtsom stangs gsar ba zhig spel ba yin/gzhan yang mkhas dbang 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtshos gong smras legs bshad rtsom stangs kyi legs cha yongs su bsdus nas rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos zhes bya ba le'u nyer gcig dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos mdzad de/ legs bshad kyi rtsom stangs gong nas gong du spel ba yin no/ /smras pa/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi pir rtse las/ /thon pa'i leṭa par bshad pa'i bstan bcos rnams/ /rang re gangs can rtsom rig bang mdzod du/ /'od 'bar nor bu gcig tu ci yang snang / /de yang 'dzam gling rig gnas dga' tshal du/ /legs bshad ces pa'i me tog mtshar sdug cig /rnam par bzhad pas phyi nang mkhas pa yi/ /yid kyi bung ba dbang med phyogs 'dir 'khor/ /'di ltar legs bshad kyi che ba brjod pa dang rtsom rig gi rin thang dpog pa ni/ rtog bzo dang sgro 'dogs kyi gtam tsam ma 7

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yin te/ bstan bcos de dag gi dngos gzhi dang de las byung ba'i phan yon gyis bsgrubs pas so/ /'o na legs bshad bstan bcos las byung ba'i phan yon ci yod ce na/ gzhan phan dge phyogs la mos pa dang sdig pa mi dge ba spong dgos pa'i slob gso gtong ba dang gcig yon tan la bstod cing blun rmongs la smad pa'i bsam blo spel ba dang gnyis/ las la brtson pa dang le lo spong dgos pa'i gnas lugs bstan pa dang gsum/ che ba la gus shing chung ba la gces pa'i lugs bzang spel ba dang bzhi/ mthun sgril la dga' zhing dbyen 'byed la sdang ba'i spyod bzang dar spel gtong ba dang lnga'o/ /'di lta bu'i phyogs lnga las bslab bya'i tshul gyis gdams te/ mi rnams kyi bsam blo dag sbyong dang kun spyod legs skyong byed pa la phan yon dpag dka' ba byung zhing / bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas dpal yon dang bsam blo'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun byed pa dang spyi tshogs mthun sgrig byed pa la phan nus gzhal dka' ba bton pa yin no/ /da res mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis legs bshad 8

sngon 'gro'i gtam/bstan bcos de dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs zhes pa'i dpe tshogs par skrun byas pa de/ spyi tshogs la phan pa'i dge mtshan dang / rig gnas la phan pa'i don snying ldan pa zhig yin no/ /gna' mo'i legs bshad bstan bcos kyis/ /spel ba'i dgongs pa'i dge mtshan de/ /deng gi bsam blo'i dpal yon gyi/ /don snying dang mthun e ma rmad/ /ces spyi lo2006lo'i zla3pa'i tshes24nyin gyi na ba blo bzang chos grags kyis bris pa'o/ /bkra shis/ dge'o/ /

dkar chagadakar chagami'i chos lugs kyi bstan bcos me tog phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (1)lugs zung ba dan g.yo ba'i legs bshad rlung gi bstan bcos zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (27)'jig rten mi chos dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya gsal bar ston pa'i legs bshad zla ba'i bstan bcos zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (48)legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos lugs gnyis yal 'dab brgya ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (60)legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos lugs gnyis rlabs phreng brgya ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (91)dam pa chos lugs kyi rin po che'i bstan bcos legs bshad 1

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (134)dam pa chos lugs kyi me'i bstan bcos thar lam gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (161)dam pa chos lugs kyi lcags kyi bstan bcos legs bshad dgos 'dod 'gugs pa'i lcags kyo zhes bya ba bzhugs so (182)legs par bshad pa sa'i bstan bcos lugs gnyis 'od brgya 'bar ba'i dbyig gi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /(201)

bhed wa da sngocho saya/sang dzo ba'i/ ༄7/ /mi'i chos lugs kyi bstan bcos me tog phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so//sum pa ye shes dpal 'byor/ṭ+wāṃdzes sbyaspu~Xsasdodra'ilhapy-i lhar guzlobatudakyi//py-i maṭ+wāṃ nge 'aler phudzhai ngags mas ma zaṭ+wāṃ//mjin dzñomi~X gas razlo rgyur ༵gyur ba//'ag na sagatsangasdu/ ldan na//mkhas bluṭ+wāṃ bzang r+shan trī' dgra dbyadī dasbyin spun//gna~X sa bar ban nga yang ṭ+wāṃs gar //khab na ṭ+wāṃgs zlol ngarnyi bapy-i chuceltarade//d+dhidapar gas ༵ bamin nyir kās yang // sna mtshan zla skar sa blon ༵ ṭ+wāṃs rdor//dana~Xlabaza~Xngan ldaṭ+wāṃ dashid //mkhas da mang gas mun nga chu nga tshal//

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de gnas gnam sa'i rgyan 'gyur 'ja' shar mtshungs/ /bzang ngan spyir mi mtshungs te sman dug 'gran/ /bye brag mkhas blun gnyer bya spyod mi 'dra/ /ngang ba mtshor 'bab bya rgod dur khrod 'bab/ /blo ldan rig gnas ya mtshan rigs la mgu/ /don med don log don dman dga'/ /khu byug gnam chu phag rdzing mi gtsang 'tshol/ /mkhas skyon mi gos rmongs pa skyon rang bzhin/ /gangs ri rdul bral sol ba bkrus kyang nag /skal ldan yon tan skal zhan skyon 'go sla/ /thang la zla zer gcong rong mun 'bab sla/ /dam pa phyi ma'i don gnyer gcig shos min/ /'brug sgra rma byas re mod 'ug pas min/ /bzang pos dge spyod ngan pas sdig las spyod/ /bung bas me tog sha sbrang mi gtsang spyod/ /blo gsal bzang las blo zhan ngan las mkhas/ /2

mi'i chos lugs kyi bstan bcos/shel bzos de la tshon bsgyur nor bur snang / /chu skyar zhi dul tshul gyis nya rnams gsod/ /mkhas pas mi smra sgrub 'grub blun go ldog /star kha 'bras bu 'dam bu me tog tsam/ /blo rtul gang thos bder 'dzin mdzangs pas min/ /rdul rlung rjes snyeg nyi zer g.yo ba min/ /dbang rnon sgra nyung smra gang rdo'i ris mtshungs/ /khyab gang la 'ang mthar 'ong legs dpyad 'jug /gser mkhan bdar bsregs bcad brdungs bzhis brtags len/ /mi rtsom rtsom gang mthar ma phyin mi 'dor/ /rtul pos smra mang chu yi ris ltar g.yo/ /grags rjes 'brang 'jug ri bong cal rgyug 'dra/ /rlung gis rdul bzhin mang rtsom mthar thon nyung / /mkhas gsal blun 'thom snang dang mun pa'i zla/ /mkhas blun 'chad phyed pi wang brag brdung 'dra/ /3

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kun gyis bkur brnyas mi 'dra zhwa lham mtshungs/ /mi mkhas rang skyon mi mthong gzhan skyon mthong / /mig rang rab rib mi mthong zla ri mthong / /mkhas pas kun mthong me long bzung lta 'gran/ /blang dor mi shes las lhag long ba su/ /yon tan med dbugs rgyu yang mgar sbud spun/ /blun por rig gnas ci dgos 'on par glu/ /phag la zas zhim long bar snang bas ci/ /rig pa'am nor rnyed ngan khengs bzang po dul/ /snye stong shing skam gyen 'greng 'bras smin dud/ /bsod nams lhag nor khron chu tshes zla 'dra/ /'dzad med rang phan lta ci gzhan la'ang phan/ /sprin char mkhar snyoms sa lu lo tog skyed/ /'byor bzhin lhag par 'jam zhi mtsho rgyas mtshon/ /rgud kyang spyod pa mi 'gyur 'gyod zhum med/ /zla nyi nub dang sgrib pas ci ste nyams/ /4

mi'i chos lugs kyi bstan bcos/bsod nams gzhan nor lhag chu zad rdzing mtshungs/ /dom bzhin nyes spyod shing rtser 'dzeg thal 'gran/ /de'i nor rang gzhan mi phan mtha' ru gnod/ /rtsub shing me 'bar shing bsregs mthar thal 'gyur/ /ngan rgud tshe 'jam 'byor tshe gzhis ngan mngon/ /zla ris tshes smin rgyas tshe lhag par gsal/ /rtsub mis bsdus kyang sbrul mthong ltar kun 'bros/ /dul ba bung bas me tog mthong bzhin 'ded/ /mkhas pa legs bshad blo gsal rig bslab dang / /blun zas cal col gnyid 'khrigs ngoms med de/ /rgyal dpon nor dang rgya mtsho char dang chu/ /me ni shing skam 'gro kun bde ngoms med/ /blun zhan don chung yon tan phra mos tshim/ /khab mig skud phra rmig rjes chus dgang sla/ /dam pa mtho thob kyang kun bde sdug shes/ /nyi ma mthor slebs ri lung thang gshong gsal/ /5

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ngan mthor slebs gzhan skyid sdug gtan mi mthong / /ri mtho'i rtser phyin gshong yang thang ltar mthong / /mkhas chos las phral nya mo chu bral 'dra/ /blun dge la spra byi long sar bton spun/ /dam pa rtag spro nags mdzes khu byug zla/ /mi ngan rgyun 'khrugs btson chud rkun mar mtshungs/ /chu la til snum steng khyab mar 'khyag bying / /dam pas yon tan sba la blo chung 'phyar/ /rgya mtshor rin chen bying la shing bal g.yeng / /rig bslab bzang la yon tan ngan skyon 'gyur/ /char babs nya phyis mu tig sbrul khar dug /yon tan ldan pa chung yang chen pos bkur/ /zla tshes phra yang dbang phyug spyi bor bcings /de med chen po yin yang bkur ba min/ /sa chen yongs kyis rkang pas brdzis la ltos/ /mkhas gcig yongs zil gnon ltar blun mang min/ /

mi'i chos lugs kyi bstan bcos/seng gcig klad brgya bskyod kyang khyi khris min/ /rgyal dpon rang yul rig bslab yul kun mchod/ /sgron me nang gcig nyi ma gang du'ang gsal/ /mkhas gang phyin kyang 'jigs med sgyu rtsal rgyu/ /zhes mtshungs blun po bag gsar byis phrug zla/ /dam pa yon tan che bzhin mi dregs 'jam/ /gzhon yang tshul gnas rgas kyang gdung med spro/ /gzi brjid che yang kun byams bkur kyang dul/ /snum stong ltos med rin chen sgron me yin/ /gshis ngan rig bslab nga rgyal 'gran sems rgyu/ /chu la me 'bar mtshungs log de'i yon tan/ /brang 'gro'i mgo la nor bu skye 'dra zhing / /tsan ljon khyud sprel sbrul gnas bzhin sus bsnyen/ /bzang por phan gdags 'tsho bar 'byor ma zad/ /rgud kyang brjed med dung dkar bsregs kyang dkar/ /de la gnod byas khros kyang tshur phan mang / /7

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ rnga la dbyu gus brdungs na sgra snyan grags/ /chos srung khros pas lhag par skyong min nam/ / ngan la gnod byas lta ci phan la'ang 'tshe/ /gshin rje khros na smos ci 'dzum yang gsod/ /de la phan byas phal cher skyon du mthong / /sgron me'i snang bar srin bu log snang rgyu/ /gaṅgā'i chu mngar rgya mtshor tshwa chur ldog /dam pa khros kyang 'dum sla gshis ngan min/ /gser ni sra yang bzhu nus rtswa 'jam min/ /ngan pa cung zad la khro cher mgu dka'/ /gos gsar dri ngan 'go sla 'bad sel dka'/ /bzang po bsten sla ngan dang gtan 'grogs dka'/ /chu bum gang ba khur sla phyed can dka'/ /bzang bsten yon tan bde skyid ngang gis 'phel/ /ri rab gnas bya rtswa la char babs 'dra/ /mi ngan bsten gang mthar 'phung myu gu dug /8

mi'i chos lugs kyi bstan bcos/shing srin rma 'bu dre'u sdom phrug mtshungs/ /bzang dang che 'grogs mthor 'gyur dgras mi tshugs/ /ljon drang 'khri shing chu thigs mtshor lhung zla/ /ngan pa'i chos nor la re mthar 'phung nges/ /me mched ma la tsan+dan gyis kyang bsreg /yon tan slob dka' ngan skyon ngang gis 'go/dri zhim 'go dka' mda' dug sbal rma sla/ /mkhas pa'ang ngan khrod ring gnas skyon 'gos srid/ /chu 'dam 'dres nang ngad pa'i dri can 'gyur/ /blun khrod blo ldan lhung na dam pa dran/ /nyi mas gdungs na lhag par zla 'od 'dod/ /rmongs pas mkhas mthong seng ger 'brug sgra 'dra/ /blun mthong tsha gdung ga bur 'phrad ltar dga'/ /rmongs khyur mkhas las g.yo can mgo mtho bkur/ /mun khrod shing rul ljang gsal me long min/ /blun brtan dad thob rtogs skye myur ba'ang srid/ /9

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/byi ba pha wang ba lang spu ngar 'gyur/ /dam pa'i drung du blun sgra brag ca'i zla/ /nor bu'i gam du 'ching bus gzi mi phyin/ /mkhas khrod rmongs 'thom blun khyur mkhas gnas min/ /ngang khyur 'ug pa phag khrod nya mi mdzes/ /mkhas pa'i bya bzung dben gnas yang na bkur/ /me tog dben ring gnas sam spyi bo'i rgyan/ /blun po'i bya bzung gzhan 'tshe'am rang nyams sdod/ /mda' brdeg gzhan rmas yang na rdor brda' 'chag /mkhas mchod ngan tsam blun bkur ci thob 'khyer/ /'o sbrang rim len ba bung sgras rgyun gcod/ /me tog mkhan gyis de tsam blang rgyan phyang / /bud shing sol mkhan rtsad nas 'byin min nam/ /blo ldan yon tan gyis gnon thabs kyis bsrung / /mda' drang gis gsod phub 'khyogs kyis lus bsrung / /blo zhan gnon skyob chung nus che mi nus/ /0

mi'i chos lugs kyi bstan bcos/rlung gis sgron me chung gsod nags me sbor/ /mkhas pas mi bsrun thabs sam rtsub mos 'dul/ /dngul chu'i g.ya' rtsi sbyangs na bdud rtsir 'gyur/ /yang na rta rgod bu smon gser brdungs 'dul/ /blun pos rdo brag brdeg bzhin phan tshun 'phung / /dam pa grong gnas kyang dul rdzi bo 'dra/ /mi bsrun dben par gnas kyang stag gi spun/ /ngan pas dbyen byed bzang pos de 'dum 'bad/ /khab phug bu ga skud pas rim gyis 'geng / /rlung gis rdul gtor char bas gnon par byed/ /ngan las yon tan 'byung srid 'dam las pad/ /mi da 'tshong rkang brdeg mya ngan med shing bzhad/ /bzang las skyon srid sgron me'i rtser du 'byung / /chen po khros rgyal rdo char gnam lcags 'dra/ /chung khros rang pham chung 'phrad rdo thal 'gran/ /dman drang bsten mkhas 'khor grogs mchog 'gyur srid//11

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bam sgrub dngos grub gser du 'gyur la ltos/ /rang bstod che na gzhan 'phya blun khyur 'gro/ /smyug ma me tog shar na shing rang skam/ /gzhan skyon mi brjod rang la'ang de yod srid/ /mi gtsang gyen gtor phyed tsam rang mgor 'bab/ /rang la phun tshogs ldan kyang gzhan mi brnyas/ /chu gting ma brtags brgal nas chus khyer mang / /ngan mang brnyas min byi'u mang 'phur gyis/ /nyi sgrib rgyu spun mang 'dom gzhig dka' yod/ /ma brtags dgos med tshig rtsub smra mi rung / /smyo smra yid mi ches shing rang gzhan gnod/ /lag mtshon rmas sos kha'i mtshon rma sos dka'/ /gser snod chag kyang bzo sla rdza chag min/ /grogs la'ang gsang tshig mi smra khros tshe 'tshe/ /byi bas dgun rmugs dug ni dpyid dus ldang / /brtan 'jam smra nyung mi la bzon bya dgos/ /12

mi'i chos lugs kyi bstan bcos/so ka'i sprin bar nyi mas lhag par gdung / /tshul chos rdzun g.yo shes sla yid mi rton/ /byis pa 'o dron kha tshig zhor phu 'debs/ /grogs bslu mi byed ngang mtshor mtshan zla gzugs/ /par rtsar 'khrul sun nyin pad dngos rtsar dogs/ /kun la drang min 'khyog lus shing drang gcod/ /rtag tu gnyen min 'dam bu sus mi gcod/ /kun la btsan min rin chen kun 'bigs byed/ /pha lam ra rus gcod pa ma mthong ngam/ /ha cang 'dod che nga la nus rgyal spun/ /nor gnyen chung thal byi'u chung mas bor 'dra/ /nor gsog cung zad nges 'phel grog mkhar mtshungs/ /ha cang bdog spel 'dzad myur mig sman ltos/ /nor dang rig pa mdza' bzang rgyun du dgos/ /me lcags bzang yang spra sdo 'bral med dgos/ /bag med ngan las byol dpa' mi byol blun/ /13

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ —seṅge mi gtsang la byol smyon g.yang mchong / /mi lcogs mi 'os bskul kyang ci la 'jug /zas nor byin bstod tsam dgos mer mchong ngam/ /bzang pos phan lan myur 'jal ngan pas min/ /gshin sar btab 'khrungs tshwa sgo can sar min/ /nye gnyen 'tshe na dgra yin ring phan gnyen/ /lus na dgra yin dbe+en ri'i sman phan mthong / /mi mthun nye ring yid mthun ring yang nye/ /chu pad mi 'dres zla 'od ku mud 'grogs/ /dam pa'i tshig rtsub tsher 'bras gtar bsreg 'dra/ /sems ngan snyan sgra gser ri'i dug chur mtshungs/ /gzhung ngan rgud tshe 'dor kyang gzhung bzang min/ /pags rnying sbrul 'dor ma yis bu mi 'dor/ /rgyal ngan bshes 'grogs nye du khyim mtshes ngan/ /yul ngan khengs gtum 'thab dga' 'tshogs bsnyen 'jigs/ /14

mi'i chos lugs kyi bstan bcos/khyad par mdza' bo ngan 'dra'i dgra med de/ /mtshon dug mche sder rwa can mi bsrun mtshungs/ /rtswa me sprin gyis brang mda' bzhin 'gyur g.yo/ /'byon dus mngon du snyam smra rtse 'dzum bstod/ /rdzun dbyen phrag dog gzhan skyon gleng la dga'/ /ngang thung mgu dka' drin brjed phan lan med/ /ngo tsha khrel 'das dregs rgod g.yo sgyus bslu/ /lkog song mi snyan mtshang gsang dgra la'ang sgrogs/ /dug mdzes 'phyon ma rgya shug 'bras bu'i spun/ /de yis gnod ltar dgras kyang ga la nus/ /seṅge rkang 'thung rang skyes srin bu za/ /yon tan mi 'dzin skyogs gsog chu chag zla/ /kha sems mi mthun khong rul ljon mdzes dang / /dug zan rma bya gser gyi snag bum mtshungs/ /ngan la gros gdab sbrul la 'o blud 'dra/ /dug rims sman sngags kyis thub mi bsrun min/ /15

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang bzhin ngan mir gdams ngag byin mi phan/ /kha ba nyi mas gdung yang grang rang bzhin/ /ngan la phan brgya btags kyang nyes gcig 'khrug /rim bskyed me tog ser bas skad cig 'joms/ /blun gtum mdza' byas khyi sprul la rtsed dang / /mchil rtse'i sha la chags pa'i nya mo 'dra/ /mi ngan 'brel med mi la'ang gnod pa skyel/ /me tog gnod med gnas kyang ba mos skem/ /ma rabs mtho sar bton kyang ngan spyod gnyer/ /khyi gu khang steng bton kyang thur la blta/ /ngan goms bzang ltar bcos kyang rang mtshang ngom /spre'ur za 'og bklubs kyang rang spyod ngom/ /g.yo can snyan bstod gus tshul bslu ched de/ /srang 'tshong dga' 'dzum skyes pa 'brid ched tsam/ /don smra mang min dgra gang yod mi shes/ /rtswas g.yogs me dong dug bum kha 'o 'gran/ /16

— mi'ichosalugs kyi bstan bcos/dgras kyang phan tshun gtam snyan yid brtan med/ /byi las lus skum rngon pas glu len gsod/ /dgra la gzos byas tshig 'jam smra bas 'dul/ /rta rgod byug cing 'phrug pas 'dul min nam/ /seng bong chu skyar bya gag bya rog khyi'i/ /bslab spyod nyid la dgra yis mi tshugs grags/ /nor med zas zhim gos rgyan 'dod dga' khengs/ /rig pa ma sbyangs rtsod rtsom bzhad gad rgyu/ /dka' thub can tsho sngar dgra ha cang mdza' /dpa' 'thab rma med yid mi ches pa'i gnas/ /phra ma rdzun tshig yid rton ha cang rgod/ /tshig rtsub 'gran brnyas phrag dog bslu 'khrug gzhi/ /dge sbyor rtsed 'jo btsun pa 'tsho sdig 'ga'/ /rgyal dpon grong nyul rdzun smra mi rigs las/ /blo stobs ldan rgol bya mang mi lcogs rtsom/ /bogs med tshong byed rtsed mang 'khon ngan blo gtong ba/ /17

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dben rdzun khengs g.yo rku 'phrog kha rbad che/ /mi chen 'du 'dzir g.yeng dogs nyes spyod las/ /khe phran tsam pa'ang gtam ngan 'ong mi 'dzem/ /mi nyan bslab bya rgyal can mtshang 'bru ba/ /drin can sun byed dgra bo gnya' bar shor/ /sna thung mi la ku re rang 'phung gzhi/ /'dod gdung khrel 'dor bsres gdung stobs mdangs med/ /nad gdung gnyid bde ngal dub brtson 'jigs med/ /sred che sdig ltung dmus long gzugs mi mthong / /dregs che rang skyon rmongs mis chos mi mthong / /'dod ldan 'dod spyod rkam nor ngoms med de/ /me 'dong brag ca spos snod gzar bu kha/ /ji bzhin yin sogs gzugs mdzes dogs ngoms med/ /phye leb ri dwags sbrang nya glang po ltos/ /rgyal po bud med blo gzhon g.yo can mis/ /18

mi'i chos lugs kyi bstan bcos/'khrid sla long ba yur chu 'khri shing 'dra/ /sems kyis chos dang sbyor bas rig pa bsrung / /rigs ni ngang tshul byi dor gyis lus bsrung / /zho gsar chang gsar sha skam gzer bzhin zas/ /nyin gnyid sems las zas log lus stobs 'phrog /sha gsar dar ba 'bras chan chu dron khrus/ /dus bzhir yul mthun sbyor shes lus stobs rgyas/ /phyi thag thung la 'phral dga'am kha 'jam yang / /gting rtsub dregs 'brel gal chung gtam las 'bad/ /sdug bral ngan 'gror dbus dus mdza' bos dor/ /rang mis brnyas smod bu lon yid gdung rgyu/ /zhi dul spro ring mthun 'dzum gsong por smra/ /'dod pa nga rgyal sred chung khur cher med/ /sems yangs 'du long rtsod par rtag mi 'gro/ /grogs 'khor spo bsten mi mang bde skyid gnas/ /phrad ma thag mir mdza' dang blo gtad spong / /19

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dga' 'phral 'dzum che khros 'phral bzhin bsdu sogs/ /mi zhim kha gnyer zhim hub che mtshon 'dor/ /yongs la kha 'jam khong grim spyang po'i phul/ /khengs ldan gus tshul bstod mgu tha mal zas/ /blo gtang mtshang 'bru blo gsal bden smra dga'/ /mkhas pa zab bshad blun po rang mthun mgu/ /mkhas mthong bag gtong rgyal ma lan re tsam/ /rgyan mchog yon tan bsrung mchog gnod bzod nus/ /grogs mchog mi bslu bde mchog sems skyid pa/ /sbyin mchog sbyin gsum mdzangs mchog rang don mkhas/ /dpon mchog spyir snyoms 'khor mchog sun med yin/ /rtul phod brtson brtan stobs chos blo ldan dpa'/ /tshod shes pha rol gnon mkhas lha 'dre'ang 'jigs/ /mkhas kyang mi khengs phyug dpa' kun mthun dul/ /'byor che gtong phod rig bslab bstod bya'i gnas/ /yon tan shes rab bslab pa rigs nas so/ /20

mi'i chos lugs kyi bstan bcos/phyug dpa' rang las che bkur de'ang tha dad/ /dregs kyang blo zhan che yang yon tan chung / /rab byung bslab lhod rgyal dpon rigs rus dman/ /tshogs brtson gzhon nu phyug po ser sna che/ /dpa' bo blun kyang gzhan la brnyas nas smod/ /rang mnyam rang bstod khengs na 'gran pa'i gnas/ /bar ma kun zhi btang snyoms byams yul lo/ /dbul dang sdar ma blun po rtswa dum bzhin mod la/ /brgya nang phyug po stong po stong khyur dpa' bo dkon/ /'bum khrod mkhas dkon rin chen dbang rgyal 'gran/ /ri kun seng ge nags kun tsan dan dkon/ /srog nor bde sdug dgra gnyen grogs mi brtan/ /phral glog chu bur mtsho dwangs dbang gzhu 'dra/ /mkhas pa'i snyan grags brtsams pa'i bstan chos brtan/ /tshangs pa'i rig byed brag brkos yi ge mtshungs/ /dam pa rgyal dpon dpa' phyug yul dus ring / /21

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bskal kyang grags pa'i pho nyas nye bar byed/ /dpag tshad bzhi khri'i nyi 'od sar 'bab 'dra/ /khyab 'jug mang bkur rgyal gtam da bar gnas/ /bkur bsnyis mi dregs brnyas kyang mi 'khrugs pas/ /dus min mi smra skabs bab rgyas zab smra/ /nye ring kun gyi yid 'phrog sgro mdongs 'dra/ /'gyur med ya mtshan cher 'god mkhas 'tshal lo/ /mdor na ya rabs spyod nyams ngan dad dus/ /yul dus dgra gnyen bar bstun bya spyod gang / /rnam dpyod kyis brtags rang rang 'tshams 'os 'jug /de nyid 'jig rten spyang po'i yang rtse'i phyir/ /mkhas dang rlom khengs dam pa zob can nor/ /btsun dang tshul 'chos glen dang drang po nor/ /blo shed che dang blun dpa' jo bzang brdzu/ /zog por tshe blos btang ba nor ba yod/ /pho rgod yin min dgra gnyen 'dul skyong dus/ /22

mi'i chos lugs kyi bstan bcos/zab dang mi zab gtam las gsang mi gsang / /grung dang mi grung rang mgo thon mi thon/ /spyang glen rang don nor mi nor gyis shes/ /rje dpon byed tshe pham len rang 'dod bskyung / /mi che yon tan can khyur tshud khengs bskyung / /skyid dus mir bstun sdug tshe khog yangs dgos/ /sems kyi 'char sgo mang yang khar mi 'byin/ /bzang bstod ngan smad snga min phyis 'gyur mang / /ma bcos mi lcogs mi nges la 'jug min/ /chung ngu'i rkyen la'ang ma brtags dga' spros min/ /bzang nang mi sems mgo stong ngag mi nyan/ /dper na gzhan la mi gtong rang la 'khor/ /shes bzhin khyad gsod btul ba phyis 'byung mod/ /dgra dngos gdong thug rtsub spyod shin tu 'bad/ /cha rgyus med mir blo gtad phyis 'gyod srid/ /gnyen mdzar phrag dog che na nam zhig 'khon/ /23

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'khor g.yog bran la rtsub che 'khor mkhan nyung / /rang nyer skyon bshad phral gnod 'dra phyis phan/ /sngar dgrar gyur myong mi brtan ngan sems can/ /mi 'os dkrugs shing byed mir gros mi 'dri/ /mkhas goms rgan drang sha tsha can la 'dri/ /gros mthil thog tu ma khel sgrogs de blun/ /ha cang dpyad mang gros 'jigs 'grub nges sgrub/ /ma bsam zhal lce ma grub kha so snga/ /ser snas nor gsog kha 'thab tsam rgyal rlom/ /'dod cher nor bstan mkhas pa ris su bor/ /mi ngan mnga' 'dus bya mang mchis yul dpon/ /zas nor la sred dka' las mang mi'i g.yog /snying gtam phyir sgrogs kha lag mi gtsang 'grogs/ /mi thub la bsdo 'jun skyen mna' za mtshang / /ngang ring blo stobs nor 'byor pha rol gnon/ /sred chung gsar 'grogs mi che shin tu brtan/ /24

da wa :/stu/35bsu yi/ba/thab /spre bstan ba3drob//yongs phan dpon bsten 'phral phugs kun tu bde/ /de yi legs nyes gang bzhed la bstun gnad/ /sha tshas bzang sgrub skyon sel phyi thag ring / /skyid sdug gang 'tshe'ang mi bshol mtho dman rer/ /dga' mgu mi che grogs bsten de'i mdza' dang / /lkog tu mang smra nor 'brel rgyal skugs spong / /dka' las mi sun ci bcol nyan 'khor bsten/ /de la mi bstod yid byams phan sgrub gces/ /nyes 'dod gdong lpags mthug pa'i nye du las/ /ngo tsha khrel yod blo ldan dgrar bsnyen skyid/ /des na ya rabs spyod gtsang dge bar spyod/ /chang spong 'tshong zad mi 'tshe gus sbyin mchod/ /tshangs gnas bzhi ldan mngon mtho'i rgyu bcu drug /gzhan yang dkon mchog la gus dam chos brtson/ /che bkur rigs mtho rgan la phu dud byed/ /mdza' bshes gzhung bsring yul phan mig yar blta/ /25

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yid drang spyod mkhas g.yo bral phrag dog med/ /spyir snyoms sems yangs bud med yid mi gtod/ /theg che ngag 'jam smra mkhas mi chos gtsang / /bcu drug la gnas mi gang bzang po'i phul/ /de yang zlum dril kha nyung khog yangs la/ /gtam drang nye ring mi byed bsam rno gtong / /rang gzhan don spyi bsgrub mkhas rang don chung / /blo brtan gang la'ang tshod zin mi de mtshar/ /'on kyang mi chos mkhas tsam gtan bde mchog /thob dka' de'i phyir thar lam la brtson rigs/ /dge 'dis kun kyang mi chos lha chos dag /gtsang ma dpyad de byang grol myur thob shog /ces mi'i chos lugs kyi bstan bcos me tog phreng mdzes zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sum pa mkhan pos lcags sbrul lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes dga' bzang gnyis la bris pa'o/ /26

legs par bshad pa rlung gi bstan bcos/༄༅/ /lugs zung ba dan g.yo ba'i legs bshad rlung gi bstan bcos zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dkyil zur blo bzang sbyin pa/oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /lus can kun gyi nor 'dzin la/ /byams brtse'i grib bsil rtag snyoms pa'i/ /sangs rgyas dpag bsam ljon pa de/ /dad pa'i rlung gis bskyod de bsngags/ /tshogs gnyis mthar son sangs rgyas de'i/ /sku gnyis mngon du byed pa'i thabs/ /lugs gnyis blang dor g.yo ba'i rlung / /don gnyis 'grub phyir 'di na spro/ /27

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/don bzang tshig sbyor phun tshogs pa'i/ /legs bshad gtam gyis gzhan yid 'phrog /dri zhim 'phro ba'i pad tshal gyi/ /rlung gis sna dbang tshim pa bzhin/ /skye bo kun dang mthun phyir du/ /dag snang sbyong la 'grogs bde bgyi/ /char ldan rlung gi shing rta la/ /'jig rten thams cad dga' ba yin/ /skyid sdug legs nyes ci 'byung ba/ /sngon bsags las kyi 'bras bu ste/ /rlung gis chu dkyil bsrubs pa las/ /ri gling khor yug rim par chags/ /phugs su phan pa'i don chen de/ /ngang ring 'bad pas bsgrub par bya/ /28

legs par bshad pa rlung gi bstan bcos/lo stong du mar rlung g.yos pas/ /'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor grub/ /rang gzhan su la'ang mi phan pa'i/ /bya ba ngan pa bshol na legs/ /dgun gyi kha rlung 'tshub dus su/ /sa bon btab kyang phan pa med/ /bya ba gang dang gang byed kyang / /'grub dang mi 'grub brtags nas bya/ /rtswa dang nas sran phye ba'i tshe/ /rlung bo 'byung min brtags nas bya/ /mchog gsum mchod cing gsol btab na/ /gang brtsams bya ba yid bzhin 'grub/ /ston dus rlung gis rtswa dang 'bru/ /so sor phye nas 'dod don 'grub/ /29

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gtam la mtshon cha med na yang / /mi snying dum bur gtong ba dang / /rlung la gshog pa med na yang / /mkha' la 'gro zhes rgan rabs smra/ /des na rtsub po'i tshig spong la/ /bzhin 'dzum 'jam po'i tshig smras nas/ /mtho dman 'bring gsum skye bo kun/ /mgu bar bgyis la blo ma gtod/ /pha rol po yis thos dogs med/ /snyam du skyon brjod mi bya ste/ /gtam ni bya spu rlung 'khyer dang / /'dra zhes sha tsha can rnams smra/ /pha rol gzhan skyon brjod pa na/ /rang nyid brlag pa'i rgyu yin te/ /30

legs par bshad pa rlung gi bstan bcos/me la phar ni phus btab pas/ /rang gi gdong ni tshig pa mthong /dus kyi dbang gis zhi dul can/ /ma rabs skye bo'i khrod du gnas/ /ngan pa'i rlung gis rdul khrod du/ /'jam po'i shing bal 'khyer ba mthong / /chos bzhin spyod pa'i skye bo'i dbus/ /ngan pa 'tshangs nas brlag par byed/ /rlung ngan rtsig gseng tshun chod la/ /zhugs nas ga bur rlag pa mthong / /dman pas dam pa la brten na/ /gang 'dod gnas su skyel ba yin/ /bzang po'i rlung la dris brten na/ /thag ring yul du sleb dang mtshungs/ /31

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/skye bo ngan pa 'byor thob tshe /gzhan la rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ston/ /ngan pa'i rlung chen g.yo rtags su/ /'dab chags khrung khrung thag skad sgrog /dam pa ji tsam bstod na yang / /nga rgyal cung zad skye mi mdzad3/ /rlung ni ji tsam g.yos gyur kyang / /rgya mtsho che la g.yo 'gul med/ /ngan pa cung zad bstod pa la/ /khengs pa ri rab las kyang mtho/ /mya ngam thang du g.yos pa'i rlung / /thal 'tshub gzhan las che ba mthong / /blo chen rnams la smad gyur kyang / /rang gi rang bzhin ga la 'dor/ /32

da wad legasaparabashadaparlungs yanabacos/——rlung gi grogs po'i zhugs nang du/ /gser sbram bzhu yang mdog mi 'gyur/ /blo chung cung zad smad tsam gyis/ /sdug bsngal gzhan las che ba byed/ /thang na gnas pa'i sgron me de/ /chung ngu'i rlung gis 'jig pa yin/ /dam pa'i yon tan dang ldan gyis/ /mang po'i nang du sgrog par byed/ /ha ri tsan+dan dri ngad de/ /rlung gis phyogs dang mtshams su 'gyed/ /snyigs dus skye bo phal che ba/ /chos byed skyes bur rab tu sdang / /phyogs mtshams kun nas g.yos pa'i rlung / /dar lcog dkar por sdang zhes zer/ /33

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/thos ldan nyams len la gzhol ba'i/ /mkhas de zhi zhing dul bar gnas/ /tsha ba'i gdung ba zhi byed pa'i/ /bzang po'i rlung de kun tu bsil/ /thos med mkhas 'dod can rnams kyi/ /shes rgyud rwa co las kyang gyong / /bar snang sprin med rlung bo de/ /mda' las tsha zhes kun gyis smra/ /slob gnyer dus su ma byas par/ /rjes su mkhas 'dod bzhad gad gnas/ /char sprin rlung gis gtor ba la/ /sbrang char re ba don med yin/ /blo la yar bskyed gtan med pa'i/ /slob gnyer ji tsam byas kyang ci/ /34

da ledzizizob dngasagi sa3ba zi/gsham bu rlung gis rtag g.yos kyang / /bsleb rgyu gang yang med la ltos/ /tshe 'di'i bde 'byor sgrub na yang / /chos kyis bsgrubs na mod la 'grub/ /rlung gis char gyi sne drangs te/ /zhing pa'i re ba skong dang mtshungs/ /rnam bkra don med bya ba yis/ /phun tshogs sgrub kyang thob par dka'/ /rlung gis g.yos pa'i chu ris bzhin/ /grub kyin grub kyin rlag pa mang /nor dang mnga' 'bangs rgyal po'i rgyan/ /'chad dang rtsom pa mkhas pa'i rgyan/ /stobs dang go mtshon dpa' bo'i rgyan/ /rlung dang char sprin bsil ba'i rgyan/ /35

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kha chems rlung la bskur ba'i dpe/ /mang po dag gis brjod pa bzhin/ /blo gsal rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis lhag bsam dag pas bris/ /'jig rten mi yi chos lugs kyi/ /bslab bya mdor bsdus bshad zin nas/ /da ni dam pa'i lha chos las/ /byung ba'i rim pa cung zad 'bri/ / ya rabs lugs bzang spyad pa las/ /tshe 'dir bde 'byor thob gyur kyang / /rlung ltar g.yo ba'i rang bzhin du/ /bltas nas thos bsam sgom la 'bungs/ /lam ston bla ma'i gsang gsum gyi/ /mdzad 'phrin rlung gi shing rta'i tshogs/ /36

legs par bshad pa rlung gi bstan bcos /mchog thun lo tog 'grub byed du/ /gsungs kyang skyon du blta ba mang / /dam pas thabs kyis skye bo rnams/ /chos la bskul na blo 'gyur te/ /rlung gis bskul na sems med kyi/ /ljon pa'ang gar stabs sna tshogs byed/ /dad ldan skye bo'i tshogs nang du/ /bla ma'i yon tan sgrog par byed/ /bzang po'i shing gi dri bsung rnams/ /rlung gis phyogs bcur rgyas par byed/ /phyogs bcu'i rlung gis phyogs kun tu/ /bskyod pa'i rgya mtsho'i gnya' shing gi /bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar/ /mi lus shin tu thob dkar gsungs/ /37

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de phyir dal 'byor gru gzings 'di/ /nyams len ba dan dkar pos brgyan/ /brtson pa'i rlung gis rab bskul nas/ /'khor ba'i mtsho las brgal bar bya/ /la na gcig rnyed pa'i rten bzang 'di/ /'jig kyang shin tu sla ba'i tshul/ /rlung dmar nang gi mar me dang / /mtshungs zhes 'phags pa klu sgrub gsungs/ /sprin phung rlung gis gtor ba bzhin/ /nor dang longs spyod bzhon pa sogs/ /thams cad bor te 'chi ba'i tshe/ /phan nges dam chos las gzhan med/ /shi nas gar skye gar 'gro ni/ /rang la dbang yod ma yin te/ /38

legs par bshad pa rlung gi bstan bcos/las kyi rlung gis 'gro ba gnyis/ /gang du 'khyer ba gcig tu yin/ /ngan 'gror skyes na sdug bsngal ni/ /rab 'bar mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis/ /lus ni dum bur gtong ba sogs/ /'thor byed rlung gis bcom pa bzhin/ /'jigs chen de las thar pa la/ /mchog gsum skyabs su bsten dgos te/ /nags tshal chen po mes sreg tshe/ /rlung zhig cis kyang grogs su dgos/ /bde dang sdug bsngal ji yod kun/ /dkar nag las rnams spyad las byung / /sra zhing 'thas pa'i rlung dkyil de/ /sems can spyi mthun las las grub/ /39

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dge dang mi dge chung ngu la'ang / /'bras bu bde sdug cher 'byung bas/ /yid ches dad pa'i rlung shugs kyis/ /sdig spong dge ba sgrub la bskul/ /thog ma med nas da bar du/ /bsags pa'i sdig ltung nags tshal kun/ /brtson pa'i rlung gis rab sbar ba'i/ /stobs bzhi'i me lce 'bar bas sreg /mig skyid bdag po'i bang mdzod la/ /'gran pa'i tshe 'di'i phun tshogs la'ang / /snying bo 'ga' yang ma mchis te/ /rlung gi rgyal mtshan ji bzhin no/ /'dod yon nag po brtsegs pa dang / /'khor ba'i gnas 'di ma mos 'phel/ /40

legs par bshad pa rlung gi bstan bcos/zas su za ba'i dug sbrul gyi/ /tshang dang 'dra zhes mkhas rnams gsungs/ /rnam rtog yid kyi mkha' dbyings su/ /'dod sred sprin phung 'khrigs pa rnams/ /gnyen po rlung gis ma bcom na/ /'khor ba'i rdzong las thar thabs med/ /de phyir bslab gsum 'bras bu yis/ /yongs su dud pa'i dpag bsam shing / /grags 'dod rlung gis ma bskyod par/ /rnam grol thar pa'i tshal du zhugs/ /mar gyur 'gro ba snying rje yis/ /theg chen rtsa ba brtan par bya/ /rlung rnams dal bus g.yos pa las/ /'jig rten gzhi rten rlung dkyil grub/ /41

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de nas rang don yal bor nas/ /ci byed sems can don du bya/ /ljon shing rlung gis bskul ba las/ /chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrog pa yod/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i khur chen de/ /snying stobs bskyed nas phrag tu longs/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i 'jig rten khams/ /rlung dkyil chen po gcig gis 'degs/ /theg chen sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i/ /dge rtsa mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /sa dang bar snang dbyings kyi rlung / /thams cad ma mos 'phel ba yin/ /sbyin pas mtho dman 'bring gsum gyi/ /skye bo thams cad bsdu nus te/ /42

legs par bshad pa rlung gi bstan bcos/sbyin la rtag tu brtson pa de'i/ /grags pa rlung bzhin phyogs bcur khyab/ /rgyal sras spyod pa kun bsdus nas/ /tshul khrims rin chen gsum du 'du/ /yang zhing g.yo ba'i rigs gang yin/ /rlung gi khams su 'du ba bzhin/ / khams gsum sems can dgrar langs kyang / /bzod pa sgom na grogs su khug /me la rlung gis dmag drangs tshe/ /de kun me yis grogs su 'gug /rtag gus sbyor ba'i rlung shugs kyis/ /brtson pa'i me chen rab sbar na/ /yang dag ye shes snang ba brgyas/ /le lo'i bsreg bya ma lus za /43

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bying rgod rlung gis ma g.yos na/ / ting 'dzin gsal zhing brtan pa 'grub/ /phyogs mtshams rlung gisas ma g.yos pa'i/ /dwangs pa'i mtsho nang zla gzugs bzhin/ /ji srid bdag 'dzin ma bzlog pa/ /de srid 'khor bar sdug bsngal myong / /dbugs kyi rgyu ba ma 'gags bar/ /srog gi dbang bo gnas pa bzhin/ /bdag med rtogs pa'i mtshon rnon gyis/ /nyes brgya'i rtsa ba rtsad nas gcod/ /bskal pa'i rlung shugs drag po yis/ /'jig rten 'di kun 'jig pa bzhin/ /de nas gsang sngags sgor zhugs nas/ /dam sdom bsrung ba gzhir bzung na/ /44

legs par bshad pa rlung gi bstan bcos/rlung ltar mgyogs pa'i sa chod kyis/ /zung 'jug go 'phang myur du 'thob/ /tha mal snang zhen sbyong ba'i phyir/ /rlung gi rgyal mtshan ltar bkra ba'i/ /rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /nga rgyal gsal snang 'don par bya/ /bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis rlung dbu mar/ /zhugs gnas thim gsum byung ba'i mthar /shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems gnyis/ /chos gzugs gnyis kyi sku ru ldang / /de ltar rlung gi khyad par gyis/ /mtshon byed tshig gi sbyor ba 'di/ /legs bshad chu yi bstan bcos de/ /mthong ba'i rkyen gyis byas pa lags/ / 45

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mkhas dbang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i legs bshad rgya mtsho chen po de/ /rnam dpyod blo yi rlung gis bsrubs las 'jig rten ya rabs spyod tshul nas/ /zung 'jug mngon du byed pa'i bar gyi lam gyi rim pa ma lus pa /gtan la 'be+ebs byed bstan bcos 'di ni sngon bsags bsod nams mthu las rnyed/ /tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /lugs gnyis bslab bya rlung bzhin du/ /'jig rten kun la yongs grags nas/ /blang dor byed la mthu ldan shog /ces lugs zung ba dan g.yo ba'i legs bshad rlung gi bstan bcos zhes bya ba 'di ni gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i chu'i bstan bcos de nyid mig lam du gyur cing / bla ma rin po che rnam rgyal 46

legs par bshad pa rlung gi bstan bcos/bzod pa de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sa dang me'i bstan bcos kyang yod par grags pas da dung de dag gi steng du rlung gi bstan bcos shig kyang byung na 'byung ba bzhi'i bstan bcos cha tshang ba'i rkyen gyis blo gsal rnams spro ba skyes nas bstan bcos de dag la thos bsam gyi sgo nas 'jug 'dod che ba yod re'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te bkras lhun dkyil khang grwa tshang gi khri 'dzin pa7dge slong blo bzang sbyin pa bdag gis bris pa yin pas 'di la nor 'khrul gang mchis pa thams cad mkhas pa rnams kyis dag par mdzad du gsol/ /47

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/༄tsho/ /'jig rten mi chos dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya gsal bar ston pa'i legs bshad zla ba'i bstan bcos zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dkyil zur blo bzang sbyin pa/oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /tshogs gnyis chu shel khams las grub/ /yon tan cha shas yongs rdzogs shing / /thugs rje'i 'od dkar 'bum spro ba'i/ /thub dbang smra ba'i zla bar 'dud/ /chos dang 'jig rten khrims lugs gnyis/ /'gal med mnyam por spyod pa'i tshul/ /rab gsal zla ba'i bstan bcos 'di/ /48

legs par bshad pa zla ba'i bstan bcos/mgrin pa'i mtsho nas 'don la spro/ /chos bzhin skyong ba'i rgyal po la/ /brten na 'bangs kyi don gnyis 'grub/ /zla ba'i 'od dkar la brten na/ /tsha ba'i sa/dung ba sel ba yin/ /shes ldan slob tshe ngal na yang / /rim gyis yon tan ldan par 'gyur/ /zla ba mar ngor 'grib gyur kyang / /dkar po'i phyogs su rim gyis 'phel/ /bsod nams med pa'i skye bo la/ /'byor ba thob kyang ga la rtag /zla ba yar ngor rgyas na yang / /nag pa'i phyogs su 'grib la ltos/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i skye bo yis/ /49

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/longs spyod btang yang ngang gis 'du/ /zla 'od la brten ljon shing gi / yal ga bcad kyang ngang gis skye/ /chos pas gnyen la chags sems kyis/ /khyim gyi kha 'dzin byed pa ni/ /zla 'od phog pa'i yi dwags rnams/ /tsha bas gdungs dang cis mi mtshungs/ /blo ldan rnams kyis 'phags nor bdun/ /rim gyis bsags na don chen 'grub/ /yar ngo'i dus kyi zla tshes de/ /rim gyis cha shas yongs su rdzogs/ /phyogs lhung sdang shugs ldan pa yis/ /mtho la 'gran sems byed pa ni/ /mar ngo'i dus kyi zla ba bzhin/ /50

legs par bshad pa zla ba'i bstan bcos/rang gi bsod nams nyams pa'i rgyu/ /mi lcogs bya ba rtsom pa dang / /mi thub mtho sar sdod 'dod pa/ /byis pa chung ngus zla dkyil la/ /spar 'dzin byed par 'dod dang mtshungs/ /deng dus skye bo sar 'grogs tshe/ /yid brtan thub pa dkon pas na/ /mchog gsum zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /blo gtod 'chol la gsol ba thob/ /'on kyang bzhin 'dzum tshig 'jam gyis/ /mtho dman 'bring gsum mgu bar gyis/ /sprin bral zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /'jig rten thams cad dga' ba yin/ /rang la blo gtad bcol ba rnams/ /51

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bu bzhin bskyangs nas bslab bya slob/ /zla bas 'jig rten kun+da'i tshal/ /gnyen bzhin bskyangs nas rgyas par byed/ /rang nyid yon tan mang ldan yang / /nyam chung dman sa bzung na mdzes/ /shin tu dkar ba'i khang bzang la'ang / /dgung zla'i 'od kyis byugs na mdzes/ /lhag par che che mtho mtho dang / /mjal tshe dma' dma' zhum zhum gyis/ /tsha bas gdungs la zla zer bzhin/ /rang la dam dum phan par 'gyur/ /yid brtan thub pa'i grogs bshes ni/ /thag ring yul na gnas kyang phan/ /dpag tshad du ma'i bar gnas pa'i/ /52

legs par bshad pa zla ba'i bstan bcos/'od dkar can dang kun+da bzhin/ /chos bzhin spyod pa'i blo ldan gyis/ /rnyed bkur grags 'dod che na nyams/ /dri zhim ldan pa'i pad+mas kyang / /zla ba'i 'od zer bsten na zum/ /ya rabs skye bo'i spyi bo ru/ /yon tan ldan pa bsten na mdzes/ /gaṅgā 'dzin gyi gtsug rgyan du/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes pa bzhin/ /chos dang 'gal ba'i las gcig gis/ /gcig la phan kyang rang la gnod/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shar ba'i tshe/ /kun+da bzhad kyang pad+ma zum/ /mkhas pas phyogs lhung yongs dor nas/ /53

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gzhan gyi don la zhugs gyur na/ /zla nyi'i snang bas sems can la/ /nye ring med pa 'di dang mtshungs/ /dpe mkhyud byed pa'i gdams ngag des/ /slob bu'i re ba skong nus min/ /sprin khrod zla ba'i 'od snang las/ /sgron me'i 'od la brten na bzang / /sems bskyed ldan pa'i bshes gcig gis/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don byed nus/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig gis kyang / /gling bzhi kun gyi mun pa sel/ /yon tan med na rgyan gos kyis/ /brgyan kyang dga' ba bskyed nus min/ /ri mor bris pa'i zla ba de/ /54

legs par bshad pa zla ba'i bstan bcos/mdzes kyang mdzes pa tsam du zad/ /gzhung gcig shes pa mang po'i dbus/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i mkhas pa mchog /rgyu skar bye ba'i dbus su ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'gran zla med/ /longs spyod chos kyis mi bsgrub par/ /g.yo sgyus sgrub 'dod 'khrul ba yin/ /dbang shes 'khrul ba'i gang zag la/ /zla ba gnyis su snang ba bzhin/ /rigs gzugs stobs 'byor ldan na yang / /yon tan med na gzhan phan dka'/ /nyin par zla ba shar na yang / /'od zer spro ba'i go skabs med/ /mchod sbyin gang yang mi nus pa'i/ /55

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/nor rdzas ji tsam yod kyang ci/ /chu nang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de/ /dwangs shing gsal yang snying bo med/ /nor dang longs spyod mi ldan na/ /rigs rus mtho yang brtsi ba nyung / /zla ba 'od zer ldan na yang / /sprin gyis bsgribs na re ba nyung / /chos kyi dbyings kyis kun la khyab/ /bdag nyid chen po kun la byams/ /rgyal ba'i mkhyen pas kun la khyab/ /zla nyi'i 'od snang kun la snyoms/ /zla nyi'i bgrod pa zad bar du/ /du ma'i 'gro la phan bzhed na/ /na rga 'chi ba ma byung bar/ /56

legs par bshad pa zla ba'i bstan bcos/bar mtshams med par chos la spyod/ /mdor na dus dang rnam pa kun/ /mkhas pa'i legs bshad la bltas nas/ /tshig don rnams la dpyad gyur na/ /blo gros yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ /'jig rten mi chos legs shes pa/ /de la dam pa'i chos mi dka'/ /des na zla ba'i bstan bcos 'dir/ /zhugs la rang gzhan don sgrubs shig /de ltar zla ba'i khyad par gyis/ /mtshon pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdus ni/ /gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyi/ /gzhung la brten nas byas pa lags/ /legs nyes rnam dbye cung zad shes pa'i bdag blo'i chu 57

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gter dbus nas thon/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i cha shas yongs rdzogs spyod tshul gsal byed 'od dkar gyis/ /blo yi rgya mtsho 'phel dang lhan cig 'jig rten snying gi mun sel ba'i/ /legs bshad zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di ni 'dren byed bdud rtsir bsten par rigs/ /'dir 'bad legs byas kai la shar/ /ston ka'i zla zer phog pa bzhin/ /rab dkar ji snyed mchis pa de/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces 'jig rten mi chos dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya gsal bar ston pa'i legs bshad zla ba'i bstan bcos zhes bya ba 'di ni mkhas dbang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i shing gi bstan bcos de nyid ngo mtshar bar mthong nas bsngags brjod mang du byas pa na rang gi zla bo bka' chen rgyun bskang ba nas khyed nas kyang 'di dang mthun pa'i legs bshad cig 58

bgyid dgos zhes skul ma byung ba la brten nas bkras lhun dkyil khang grwa tshang gi khri 'dzin pa7dge slong blo bzang sbyin pa bdag gis bris pa yin pas 'di la nor 'khrul gang mchis pa thams cad mkhas pa rnams kyis dag par mdzad du gsol// //maṅga lo//

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/༄7/ /legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos lugs gnyis yal 'dab brgya ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me/oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /rin chen sems kyi rtsa ba brtan/ /rlabs chen tshogs gnyis yal ga rgyas/ /sku gsum 'bras bzang snye mas dud/ /sangs rgyas ljon pa de la 'dud/ /snang ba dpe ru shar ba yi/ /rnal 'byor de la gdams ngag mang / /nags klung stug po'i do ra ru/ /shing lo'i phung po zad pa med/ /60

legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos/dpag bsam shing la brten byas na/ /dgos 'dod thams cadachar du bsnyil/ /de bzhin bshes gnyen dam pa la/ /brten na legs tshogs lhun gyis grub/ /bshes la mi gus skye bo des/ /gzhung brgya shes kyang don mi 'gyur/ /shing skam lo brgya chur 'phangs kyang / /lo 'dab skye ba srid na med/ /dad ldan rang bzhin bzang po der/ /tshigs bcad gcig tsam gyis kyang phan/ /rkang 'thung gsar ba'i myu gu de/ /chu char gzegs ma yis kyang 'phel/ /tsher ma can dang dug shing gis/ /mi dgos bzhin du sa 'di gang / /61

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi khom ngan song skye ba ni/ /sa yi rdul bzhin grangs las 'das/ /tsan dan sa mchog ljon pa de/ /'jig rten 'di na srid pa tsam/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten bzang yang / /brgya lam thob pa ma bkag tsam/ /dal 'byor snying bo ma blangs na/ /dud 'gro'i rten dang gnyis su med/ /a mra'i 'bras bu mi spyod na/ /e raṇ+ḍa dang khyad par ci/ /mdangs dang lo 'bras me tog sogs/ /ljon pa gcig kyang dus kyis 'gyur/ /skye rga na dang 'chi ba yi/ /zlos gar skad cig skad cig bsgyur/ /62

legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos/ring du 'brel ba'i shing lo de/ /lan gcig brul ba slar mi 'byor/ /mdza' ba yun ring 'khod 'khod nas/ /nam zhig gtan du 'bral bar 'gyur/ /sdong bo gshag gtub dras pa yis/ /shing mkhan myur du ngal bar 'gyur/ /bskal par de 'dra'i las bsgrubs kyang / /dmyal srung rnams ni ngal ba med/ /ji srid mi dge ma zad pa/ /de srid sdug bsngal 'khor mor myong / /dug gi sa bon gnas kyi bar/ /dug lo skye ba chos nyid yin/ /gang zhig gsum la skyabs song ba/ /de la srid zhi'i rgud pa med/ /63

da legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ljon pa che la brten pa der/ /gcan gzan gdug pas gtse mi nus/ /rtsa ba rul ba'i ljon pa la/ /brten par byed pa blun po'i rtags/ /rang yang 'khor bar bying ba la/ /skyabs su 'dzin rnams kye ma 'khrul/ /dug dang sman gyi myu gu las/ /'bras bu 'tshol ba 'gar yang med/ /dge dang mi dge'i las las kyang / /'bras bu gzhan 'byung gnas ma yin/ /thog med dus nas bsags pa'i las/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /ta la'i shing 'bras stong phrag lor/ /skam yang rlan dang 'phrad na skye/ /64

legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos/sa bon chung smin n+ya gro ta'i/ /yal 'dab rgyas pas rgyang grags khebs/ /kham gcig zas kyi sbyin pas kyang / /'bras bu 'khor los bsgyur ba 'thob/ /rnam bkra srid pa'i 'khor lo 'dir/ /don ldan snying bo 'ga' ma mchis/ / chu shing rlon pa'i sdong bo la/ /rtse rting kun na snying bo med/ /ljon shing lo brgyar skyes pa yang / /nam zhig tshe na 'gyel bar 'gyur/ /srid pa'i rtse mor phyin nas ni/ /slar yang mi bzad ngan 'gror 'gro/ /bur shing khu bas rab bsgos na/ /tig ta'i kha ba sel bar nus/ /65

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/lam gyi bden pa rab goms pas/ /sdug bsngal rtsa ba kun 'byung spong / /ka gdung lcam dang dral ma rnams/ /tshogs pas yid 'ong lding khang ste/ /lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum tshogs pas/ /thar pa dam pa'i khang bzang 'grub/ / rīdzan+tu'i sa bon de'i sa bon/ /gzhan las skye phyir thog ma med/ /mtha' med 'khor bar skyes pa na/ /pha mar ma gyur su zhig yod/ /rta glang brgya yi khur lci ba/ /shing rta chen po gcig gis 'dren/ /nyan rang kun gyis ma longs pa'i/ /khur de rgyal sras phrag na mdzes/ /66

legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos/shing gzhan 'bras bu blangs pas 'dzad/ /dpag bsam shing 'bras zad pa med/ /dge ba gzhan 'bras spyad pas 'dzad/ /byang chub sems dge phyir zhing 'phel/ /yongs smin 'bras bus spa ba yi/ /rkang 'thung de la skye bo 'du/ /'jungs med gtong ba'i dpal yon can/ /de yis skye dgu'i re ba skong / /mngon par mtho dang nges legs kyi/ /rtsa ba tshul khrims las gzhan med/ /yal 'dab g.yur du za ba yi /rtsa ba sdong bu nyag gcig yin/ /tsher ma zug pa'i lan du slar/ /khu tshur rdeg pa bzhad gad rgyu/ /67

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gnod byed la yang slar khro ba/ /rang nyid nyams pa'i rgyu ru zad/ /rgyu dus brtson pa mang btang na/ /'bras dus yon tan thams cad skye/ /rtsa ba rlan dang ma bral na/ /rtse mor lo 'bras smin par 'gyur/ /sdong bo rlung gis cher bskyod na/ /'bras su sa la 'brul ba ltar/ /bying rgod g.yeng bas rab g.yos pas/ /ting 'dzin dmigs pa stor bar byed/ /bsam gtan rnam par dag pa las/ /mngon shes la sogs yon tan 'byung / /sdong bu nyams pa med gyur na/ /me tog ge sar mgo lcog ldem/ /68

legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos/shing gi ral gri g.yul gyi ngor/ /'phyar ba dgra yi dga' ston yin/ /ltar snang nyi che'i lta ba yis/ /srid rtsa gcod 'dod kye hud mtshar/ /ha ri tsan dan bzang po yis/ /lus kyi tsha gdung sel bar byed/ /snying rje'i bcud ldan lta ba yis/ /dug gsum nad brgya drungs nas 'byin/ /shing las skyes pa'i srin 'bu yis/ /shing de zad par byed pa bzhin/ /'dod chags las skyes ye shes kyis/ /'dod chags nyes pa zhi bar byed/ /shing skya rlan gyis zin pa las/ /be+eḍūr mdangs su 'pho ba ltar/ /69

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/tha mal snang ba 'od gsal gyis/ /sbyangs te dag pa'i lha skur ldang / /yal 'dab yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /ljon pa'i grib ma kun tu bsil/ /yon tan ma lus rdzogs pa yi/ /rgyal ba skye dgu'i mgon du gyur/ /de ltar shing gi bstan bcos las/ /chos kyi lam bstan sarga ste/ /da ni 'jig rten tshul lugs 'ga'/ /bshad do rna ba blags te nyon/ /chos ldan rgyal po'i gzi byin gyis/ /dgra sde rnams kyang dbang du 'du/ /ma la yar skyes dri bsung de/ /bung ba 'gugs pa'i pho nya yin/ /70

legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos/rgyal ngan chab 'bangs gzir ba der/ /nam zhig g.yog kyang 'khor mi 'gyur/ /sran phung dbyug pas gtor na yang / /dbyug pa'i ngos la 'byar mi srid/ /blon dang 'bangs kyis ma bkur na/ /rgyal po chen po ji ltar gnas/ /gdung ma ka bas ma btegs na/ /rgyal po'i pho brang gang las 'byung / /rje dpon bzang po'i bka' drin gyis/ /g.yog 'khor mnga' thang dar bar gyur/ /ljon pa che la brten pa yis/ /'khri shing rtse mo dgung la bsnyegs/ /tsher ma'i shing la brten byas na/ /gnad du zug pa'i sdug bsngal skye/ /71

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/skye bo ngan la brten byas kyang / /phyi phyir sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig bskyed/ /chab 'bangs bde skyid rgyas pa de/ /rje dpon nyid kyi che ba'i rtags/ /rab rgyas yal ga'i khyon yangs pa/ /sdong bo rtsa ba'i mdzes rgyan yin/ /g.yog 'khor rgud pa'i sde dpon de/ /rang nyid 'byor yang ngo tsha'i rgyu/ /sdong bo ci tsam sbom na yang / /yal 'dab med na gcer bu yin/ /sdong rul rtsa bar gnas pa'i mi/ /nyin mtshan kun tu bag phebs bral/ /gtso bo ngan pa'i g.yog 'khor yang / /rtag tu sems khral gdung bas gzir/ /72

legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos/dpon ngan g.yog 'khor bros na yang / /sde dpon bzang pos bskrad kyang 'du/ /tsher shing 'bor ba'i bh+ra ma ra/ /tsū ta'i shing las bskrad kyang 'khor/ /rje dpon gsar tshe byams byed kyang / /phyi nas bsgrub dka'i dpya khral 'bebs /shing la char skyob byed mod kyang / / rjes su thigs phreng lci bar 'bab /ljon pa'i grib bsil kun la snyoms/ /nyi zla'i snang ba kun la snyoms/ /sprin gyi chu char kun la snyoms/ /rgyal po'i bka' khrims kun la snyoms/ /gtso bo bzang yang 'khor ngan na/ /de yi drung du bsnyen par dka'/ /73

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gdug pa'i sbrul gyis dkris pa yi/ /tsan dan ljon pa su yis brten/ /phyi nang smin dang ma smin pa'i/ /a mra'i 'bras bu rigs bzhir gsungs/ /mi yang sems dang spyod pa gnyis/ /dag dang ma dag dbye ba mang / /mkhas pa yon tan kun ldan de/ /rlom sems med par zhi zhing dul/ /snye ma'i khur gyis ljid pa yi/ / ljon shing rtse mo dud de gnas/ /yon tan med pa'i skye bo de/ /nga rgyal mgo 'phang ci las mtho/ /'bras bu'i bcud kyis ma bzung ba'i/ /ljon pa rengs pa chos nyid yin/ /74

legasaparabashadapashihrūgibastanabacos/—rnelhan skyes yon tan med gyur na/ /phyi tshul bcos pas ci la phan/ /yal 'dab med pa'i shing skam der/ /cod pan btags kyang ga la mdzes/ /bslab sbyang dus na g.yel ba des/ /mkhas 'dod re ba 'bras med yin/ /me tog sad kyis khyer ba yi/ /shing la 'bras bu'i re ba med/ /blo gros rtsal dang mi ldan na/ /go sa mtho yang khrel ba'i gzhi/ /shing las byas pa'i seng ge de/ /'jigs 'jigs 'dra yang snying bo med/ /dri zhim bsung dang mi ldan na/ /tsan dan yin zhes smras kyang rdzun/ /75

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dam pa'i tshul dang mi mthun na/ /dam par khas 'che don dang bral/ /dman pa rgyal sar bton na yang / /ma rabs spyod pa'i rjes su 'jug /chu shing gyen du skyes na yang / /'dab ma thur du 'phyang bar 'gyur/ / a gar dum bu brgyar gtubs kyang / /lhan skyes dri bzang mi gtong ltar/ /dam pa ci tsam rgud na yang / /bzang po'i rang bzhin ga la 'dor/ /shug pa'i lo ma mer bcug na/ /lhag par dri bzang rgyas pa bzhin/ /dam pa rnams la gnod byas pas/ /phyir zhing de yi che ba 'don/ /76

legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos/dam pa dben par gnas na yang / / grags snyan lha yis sgrog par byed/ /lho yi ri las skyes pa yi/ /tsan dan dri bsung rlung gis 'gyed/ /'khyogs pa'i shing de bsrangs na yang / /rlan dang 'phrad tshe ya yor 'gyur/ /rang bzhin ngan pa bcos na yang / /rkyen dang 'phrad tshe rang mtshang ston/ /klad chung rang bzhin ngan pa la / /yon tan yod kyang phan mi thogs/ /rtsa ba dug tu gnas pa yi/ /me tog mdzes kyang su la mkho/ / tsan dan shug pa'i ka ba gnyis/ /gdung ma 'degs pa'i nus pa mtshungs/ /77

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/snying stobs ldan na dbul phyug gnyis/ /bya ba byed pa'i dus su 'dra/ /longs spyod mnga' thang mnyam na yang / /bzang ngan las la sbyar na shes/ /phra sbom mnyam yang chur 'phangs na/ /shing gi mgo mjug shes par nus/ /mkhas pa'i skye bo yul gzhan du/ /brin zhing kun gyis bkur bar 'gyur/ /nags su skyes pa'i shing gis ni/ /gzhan du shing gi bya ba byed/ /shing bal rlung gis bdas pa de/ /ri rtser mi sdod gshong du chags/ /blo chung phyogs mthar 'khyams 'khyams nas/ /mtha' mar rgud pa'i gnas su ltung / /78

legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos/skyon gyis gos pa ches sla ste/ /yon tan slob pa de lta min/ /shing la me lce mched sla yang / /chu bo so sor gyes par dka'/ /ma rabs skye bo gnyis 'grogs na/ /phugs su rang gzhan gnyis ka 'phung / /gtsub shing zung du brdar ba yis/ /mjug tu gnyis ka bsregs par byed/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i ljon pa yang / /chu dang 'grogs na rtsa ba 'byin/ /ya rabs yon tan ldan pa yang / /grogs po ngan pas nyams par byed/ /'bras ldan shing gnyis sbyar ba las/ /'bras bu phung gsum 'byung ba ltar/ /79

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/blo dang ldan pa gnyis 'grogs na/ /sngon med legs pa'i blo gros skye/ /ljon pa'i grib bsil bsten pa yi/ /glang pos shing gi rtsa ba 'byin/ /g.yog 'khor ngan pa bsten pa yis/ /legs byas rtsa ba nyams par byed/ /shing sdong gtsug gis bkur ba yi/ /'dab chags 'gro tshe bya thal gtong / /zla grogs ngan pa bsten na yang / /nam zhig rjes ngan bzhag nas 'gro/ /ngan par ci tsam phan btags kyang / /lan du phan pa'i re ba med/ /shing gis rtag tu me gsos kyang / /me yis de nyid thal bar byed/ /80

legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos/blo dang mthu ldan re res kyang / /mchog dman kun gyi dgos pa bsgrub/ /'od ma'i gnam ru gcig gis kyang / /nyag phran stong gi bya ba byed/ /longs spyod dpal dang mi ldan na/ /rigs rus mtho yang dgos pa chung / /dgos pa'i grib bsil med gyur tshe/ /rtse mo mtho bas ci la phan/ /rtsa ba bsod nams med gyur na/ /bsags pas dbul ba mi sel te/ /sdong bo rlan dang bral ba la /yal gar chu bos byugs kyang ci/ /bun dang bskyed kyis nor spel bar/ /'dod kyang rtsa ba stor ba mang / /81

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/shing skyes bcad nas sa gzhan du/ /btsugs pa phal cher skam par 'gyur/ /g.yang sa mthon por skyes pa yi/ /sa ha kā ra'i 'bras bu bzhin/ /rang gzhan gang la'ang mi phan pa'i/ /longs spyod che de lba ba yin/ /longs spyod spel bar 'dod pa yis/ /cha shas gtong ba man ngag ste/ /ljon shing yal ga rgyas 'dod na/ /rtse mo 'breg pa thabs su bzang / /dman pas bsags kyang mi 'grub la/ /bsod nams ldan pas btang yang 'byor/ /rlan sar bcad kyang skye ba'i shing / /skam sar btsugs kyang ga la skye/ /82

legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos/lam kha'i shing gi 'bras bu de/ /byis pa'i rdo char 'bebs pa'i rgyu/ /bdag po ngan pa'i longs spyod kyang / /phal cher dgra yi g.yab mo yin/ /bsod nams dman pa'i skyes bu der/ /dpal 'byor byung na srog kyang rlag /smyug ma'i shing gi rtse mo la/ /'bras bu chags pa nyams pa'i ltas/ /bur shing gcod pa ro yi phyir/ /wa skyes gsod pa pags pa'i slad/ /don mthun 'joms pa nor gyi don/ /rgyal por rgol ba 'bangs kyi ched/ /shing la thog mar thig 'debs dgos/ /dras shing gtubs na bsgyur du med/ /83

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bya ba'i thog mar bsam dgos kyi/ /rjes nas gyod brdal blun po'i rtags/ /stabs legs tsam gyis don grub kyang / /blo dang ldan par su zhig rlom/ /lo ma 'khums nas nyal ba'i shing / /sems ldan bsgrub pa mu stegs lugs/ /srang mdor lo 'dab nyal nyil du/ /gnas pa'i shing de kun gyis brdzi/ /don med 'chol ba'i gtam mang ba'i /mi de kun la ngo thang chung / /mi ngan byas pa chung na yang / /drin che'i yus kyis rna ba 'gengs/ /bud shing rlon pa me chung yang / / dud pa nag pos tshang mang 'gengs/ /84

legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos/shing la lan gcig sbrul gnas de/ /phyis kyang mthong tshe 'jigs pa ltar/ /rku dang rdzun la gcig zhugs pa'i/ /mi der rtag tu dogs pa skye/ /tsher ma rno yang brag ri la/ /bsnun na rtse mo 'jil bar byed/ /skyes bu dam par phrag dog gis/ /smod pa rang gi dma' 'bebs yin/ /gnas min la yang dul che na/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir kun gyis brnyas/ / shing bal 'jam mo 'jam mo zhes/ /kun gyis gdan du mi byed dam/ /shing skyes drang bo mdzes na yang / /sga shing 'khyog po ci las bzang /85

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang bzhin drang na bzang mod kyang / /res 'ga' ldem po rgyal bas gsungs/ / mde'u med pa'i mda' 'phen pa/ /dgra bo spyan 'dren po nya yin/ /dgra bo 'joms pa'i mthu med na/ /don med dpa' skad ci la smra/ /gnyen la ha cang byams pa yang /'khon gyi rgyu ru 'gro ba mang /bur shing mngar mo spyod ches na/ /ma zhus sgregs pa skyur mo 'byung / /shing dgra sta re yin mod kyang / /de yi yu ba shing gis byed/ /dgra yis brtsams pa'i phung grol kyang / /phal cher rtsa ba gnyen gyis byed/ /86

legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos/sdong bo gcod pa'i thabs nyes na/ /rang gi steng du lhung bar 'gyur/ /dgra la ha cang sdang ba yang /rang gi gshed du 'gro ba mang /shing skam dgug par mi nus de/ /rlan gyis bsgos na las su rung / /dgra bo mi bsrun sems ldan yang / /thabs la mkhas na 'dul bar nus/ /nyi zlas mi phyed mya ngan med/ /na chung rkang gdub reg pas 'byed/ /legs par bshad kyang mi go ba'i/ /ma rabs la la smad pas thul/ /nags na gnas rnams khang bzang dang / /der gnas skyed mos tshal la dga'/ /87

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'tsho bas dbul ba rab byung dang / /rgyags pas myos pa khyim la phyogs/ /nags der skyes pa'i spre'u yang / /'bras bu zad na gzhan du 'gro/ /rgud tshe snying du sdug pa yi/ /bu yang gzhan gyi phyogs su 'bros/ /nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa der/ /don med nam mkha'i bya yang 'khor/ /gang na bde skyid 'dzoms pa der/ /ma bsdus par yang skye bo 'du/ /shing gi 'bras bu legs bskyangs na/ /lo 'dab la sogs zhar la 'byung / /dam pa'i chos la brtson byas na/ /srid kyi dpal yang de yis 'grub/ /88

legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos/de ltar lugs gnyis blang dor kun/ /shing gi khyad par kho na yis/ /mtshon byed gtam gyi sbyor ba 'di/ /sngon med mkhas pa'i dga' ston yin/ /gang mgrin 'o ma'i rgya mtsho ru/ /dbyangs ldan ngang mo rnam rol ba /de yi kha las legs bshad kyi/ /rba rlabs 'khri shing ci yang g.yo/ /grags snyan nor bu'i zhags pa yis/ /rgya bod 'dzin ma'i mtha' bcings pa /dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i/ /legs bshad lam la brten pa yin/ /don gyi sgo lcags mkhyid gang la/ /dpe yi lde mig khru gang ba/ /89

— legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ —de lta'i gzhung yang snang mod de/ /mkhas blun su yi dbang du byas/ /lugs gnyis blang dor shes 'dod rnams/ /dpe yi sor mo tsam min par/ /don gyi zla shel ltos shig dang / /ngo mtshar ri dwags mtshan ma yod/ /'dir 'bad legs byas n+ya gro ta'i/ /sa bon smin pa'i dge mtshan gyi/ /yal ga phyogs bcur rgyas pa yis/ /'gro ba kun gyi don byed shog /ces legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos lugs gnyis yal 'dab brgya ldan zhes bya ba 'di ni mthong snang sna tshogs kyis rkyen byas te/btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes tshwa rgan sman chur phyin pa'i lam khar gang dran sug bris su bgyis pa'o/ /90

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/༄7/ /legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos lugs gnyis rlabs phreng brgya ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me/mkhyen pa'i gting mtha' mi mngon zhing / /thugs rje'i yid bzhin nor gyis gtams/ /mdzad pa'i rlabs phreng g.yo ba can/ /thub dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho rgyal/ /rnyog bral dwangs pa'i chu rgyun gyis/ /lus can gdung ba zhi byed ltar/ /legs bshad gsar ba'i bdud rtsi yis/ /blo ldan skye bo dbugs dbyung bya/ /dri bzang bsgos pa'i chu gtsang de/ /91

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mchod yon zhabs bsil bsang gtor sogs/ /gang du byas kyang legs pa ltar/ /legs bshad gtam ni kun la mdzes/ /lugs gnyis blang dor shes pa yis /gnas skabs mthar thug don 'grub ste/ /brtag pa kun la mkhas pa yi/ /ded dpon rgya mtshor zhugs pa bzhin/ /chu phran brgal bar mi nus des/ /rgya mtsho rkyal gyis ga la chod/ /ya rabs lugs kyang mi shes na/ /chos kyi de nyid ji ltar rtogs/ / gzur gnas rig par ldan pa des/ /gzhan gyi yon tan len par byed/ /spang ljongs gtsang ma'i dal 'gro ma/ /92

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/lhung lhung zer zhing me tog 'thu/ /ngan pas phyogs mtha' bskor na yang / /skyon gyi rigs rnams sdud par byed/ /ngam grog sa ral can gyi chus/ /'dam gyi snyigs ma 'dren dang mtshungs/ /yon tan dang por slob dka' la/ /shes bzhin med na nyams pa sla/ /chu thigs bsags pas 'gengs dka' yang / /bo na cig car nyid du 'dzad/ /dka' spyad khur du 'khyer nus na/ /bya ba gang yang dka' ba med/ /chu yi nang du zhugs pa der/ /char gyis lhag par gnod mi 'gyur/ /rgyun chags brtson pa ma btang bar/ /93

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bags kyis bsgrubs na cir yang 'grub/ /chu bo dal gyis 'bab pa yis/ /yangs pa'i sa chen bskor nas 'gro/ /bya ba chen po yun gyis bsgrub/ /ngang thung 'bad pas mthar mi phyin/ /klung chen dal yang ring 'gro la/ /rba rlabs drag kyang cher mi 'gro/ /bya ba nyams kyis mi lcogs na/ /gzhan gyis rbad kyang byar mi rung / /rkyal mi shes na gzhan dag gis/ /bskul yang chu nang ci phyir mchong / /chu bo thun mong mchod yon te/ /nyi zla thun mong sgron me gsal/ /dam pa thun mong gtsug rgyan dang / /94

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/dam chos thun mong bdud rtsi yin/ /dar chen gru gzings rgya mtsho'i rgyan/ /sprin bral zla ba nam mkha'i rgyan/ /mkhas pa'i skye bo bstan pa'i rgyan/ /ru 'dren dpa' bo dpung gi rgyan/ /ya rabs mdzangs spyod dpon dang 'bangs/ /phan tshun legs tshogs gong du spel/ /rgya mtsho che dang chu bo rnams/ /res mos tshul gyis grogs su 'gyur/ /rje bo ngan dang g.yog ngan pa/ /gnyis kas gnyis ka rgud byed de/ /rdza gsar nang du chu blugs na/ /gnyis ka chud zos brlag par 'gyur/ /shes rlom dbang can mang ba yi/ /95

—legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yul khams mdun gros 'jig 'gyur te/ /g.yas g.yon kun nas chu 'bur ba'i/ /sa la mkhar khyim brtan mi srid/ /rje 'bangs mthun na dgra sde yis/ / thub dka' so sor gyes na min/ /rta yis brgal dka'i chu bo yang /mang du gyes na lug kyang bgrod/ /chos ldan rgyal pos khral bsdus kyang / /de nyid kyis ni 'bangs rnams skyong / /sprin chen rgya mtsho'i chu drangs te/ /dal gyis 'bebs pas 'dzin ma skyong / /rgyal ngan 'bangs kyi zas nor kun/ /phrogs kyang da dung ltogs shing bkren/ /rgod ma kha yis rgya mcho1re chu/ /96

legs par bshad pa chu'i bgatso cos/ 'thung gin rtag tu 'bar dang mtshungs/ /gtso bo ngan pa rtag bkur yang / /gsug dang bral ba tsam gyis sdang / /chu bo nyin zhag mang bskol kyang / /me dang bral ba'i mod la grang / /khengs dregs gdug rtsub che ba yi/ /dpon la su yang brten mi spro/ /shin tu 'khrugs pa'i rba klong du/ /nya la sogs kyang sdod mi byed/ /brtse zhing phan gdags nus pa der/ /skye bo thams cad ngang gis 'du/ /yid bzhin gyi ni rgya mtsho'i ngogs/ /'gro ba kun gyis bsten par byed/ /che mtho bsten pas dpal thob kyang / /97

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de las lhag pa'i 'jigs pa 'byung / /rgya mtsho rin chen 'byung gnas de/ /gdug can na kra'i grong yang yin/ /rgyus med mi la gsar 'grogs kyis/ /yid brtan byed pa nyams pa'i rgyu/ /rgyal sras ngang ba'i sde dpon yang / /mtsho gsar bsten pas rnyi yis zin/ /rna ba srab pa'i mdza' gcugs de/ /ring min dbyen gyis so sor gtong / /chu dang 'o ma ro gcig tu/ /'dres pa ngang ba'i mchu yis 'byed/ /mkhas pas bden rdzun brtags nas byed/ /blun po grags pa'i rjes su rgyug /chu nang cal gyi sgra bsgrags pas/ /98

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcom/ gcan gzan ri dwags phal cher bros/ /'grogs na legs spyod 'phel 'grib las/ /dge dang sdig pa'i grogs 'gyur te/ /dwangs bsil 'dra yang phan gnod las/ /sman gyi chu dang dug chur 'jog /sdig grogs g.yem ma'i 'dzum dkar las/ /sha tsha'i gdug rtsub khro gnyer bzang / /than khyer sprin gyi mdog dkar yang / /chu ldan sprin nag zhing pa'i gsos/ /blo ldan rang bzhin bzang po de/ /mchog dman bar ma kun gyis bsten/ /'jug ngogs bde ba'i rdzing bu la/ /skye bo thams cad dga' bzhin 'jug /khengs dregs spyod pa rtsing po la /99

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/don med rnams kyang dgra ru ldang / /rgyags shing 'phyar ba'i gaṅgā ma/ /dza hū khros pas hub kyis btung / /nyam chung steng du dpa' thal na/ /nyam nga'i g.yang du ltung 'gyur te/ /chu la rkyal gyis dregs pa'i nya/ /skam la yar na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rigs ngan cung zad 'byor na yang / /rgyal po lta bu'i khengs dregs 'dzin/ /gcong rong dog mo'i chu phran de/ /'ur sgra rgya mtsho'i rba klong 'dra/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams ma mthong ba/ /sa mtha'i blun po rang mthong che/ /khron pa'i chu la 'gying ba yi/ /100

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/rus sbal rgya mcho'i gtam gyis shi /tha shal rnams ni mgu sla zhing / /mgu ba'i mod la khrel yang sla/ / phu thag thung ba'i chu phran de/ /brubs dang bri ba yud tsam yin/ /ma rabs gces par bskyangs na yang / /drin du mi tshor 'khrug par byed/ /bsil ba'i chu yis bran na yang / /rdo zhun lhag par khol zhing tsha/ /dam pa rnams la gnod byas kyang / /khro med bzod pas bde bar gnas/ /btso yi sngags kyis btab pa'i chu/ /khol bzhin pa yis bran kyang bsil/ /khrel med rnams la phan btags kyang / /101

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bya ba zin na brjed par 'gyur/ /chu bo'i pha rol brgal ba na/ /gru gzings ltos pa med par 'dor / /mi ngan re re'i byed pas kyang / /yul khams chen po phung bar byed/ /drang srong gdug pa mchongs pa yis/ /si ta tshal brgyar gyes zhes grags/ /dmu rgod skye bos sun phyung rnams/ /dam pa la yang yid mi ches/ /chu zlas bslus byas ngang ba yis /nyin mo'ang pad rtsa za mi byed/ /skye bo ngan pa bcos na yang / /rkyen dang 'phrad tshe rang mtshang ston/ /chu klung 'ol ka bsgyur ba de/ /102

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/brubs tshe sngar gyi lam du 'gro/ /dam pa mtho dman 'byor rgud sogs/ /cis kyang rang bzhin mi 'gyur te/ /chu bo bsil lam tsha na yang / /rlan gyi rang bzhin ga la 'dor/ /mi bsrun skye bo gdams pa las/ /nan tur las kyis gdul bar sla/ /gos kyi dri ma 'khrud pa la/ /gtsang ma'i chu las 'gyur byed bzang / /lus can nang gi skyon yon rnams/ /phyi rol spyod pas mtshon nus te/ /chu skyar lding bas chu bo dang / /du ba las ni mer shes bzhin/ /gzhan gyi skyon yon mthong sla yang / /103

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang gi spyod tshul mthong bar dka'/ /mtsho nang nam mkha'i zla skar kun/ /gsal yang rang gi gting mi mthong / /bsam ngan g.yo sgyu'i bya ba ni/ /lam rgyug 'dra yang phugs su 'phung / /chu klung gya gyur bgrod pa yang / /bab kyis thur nas thur du 'gro/ /rigs rgyud zad 'dod bu ngan skye/ /bsod nams zad 'dod bsam ngan 'char/ /rang nyid brlag 'dod rig pa rgod/ /chu mig skam 'dod snyigs ma mang / /blun pos ngal brgyas bsgrubs na yang / /grags pa blo ldan gzhan gyis 'khyer/ /ri las skyes pa'i pad ma yang / /104

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/bskyed pa'i grags pa chu yis 'thob/ /lung rtogs yon tan mi ldan yang / /dam par sgrog pas skye bo bslu/ / sbrang char bcud dang bral ba yi/ /than khyer sprin gyi 'brug sgra bzhin/ /snyigs dus rang byung kun mkhyen rnams/ /sbyangs tshe phal ba las kyang rtul/ /rang byung chu tshan sngar tsha yang / /bskol na chu grang rjes su khol/ /dred po kha yi chos bshad mkhan/ /shes rgyud gdol ba las kyang thu/ /dgun dus rlangs pa na bun bzhin/ /'thibs pa'i klong de lhag par grang / /dam pa'i skye bo nyam thag kyang / /105

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/chos dang 'gal ba'i las mi byed/ /char sdod byi'u skom na yang / /sa la 'bab pa'i chu mi 'thung / /dge sbyor brtson par 'dod pa dang / /log pa'i 'tsho ba sgrub pa 'gal/ /me tog skyed par 'dod pa yis/ /chu tshan blugs na phan 'gyur ram/ /chen po re zhig rgud na yang / /slad nas gzi byin rgyas par 'gyur/ /'khyags pa'i sbubs su chud pa'i mtsho/ / so ka rim gyis 'phyur nas 'ong / /blo dang rtsol ba zhan pa'i mir /phun tshogs thob kyang mod la 'grib/ /rdzing chung ltag chu chad pa de/ /106

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/gang yang myur du skam par 'gyur/ /nor med mchor dang kha zhim 'dod/ /gzhung lugs ma sbyangs mkhas khur 'dzin/ /chu rkyal mi shes mtsho brgal ba/ /bsam bzhin rang sdug nyos pa yin/ /mnga' thang blo rgya skyed ches pas /bsod nams tshad las 'gong mi rung / /mtsho chung rang gi khron pa yi/ /tshad las rgyas na bo bar 'gyur/ /don chen thog tu ma babs pa'i /dus nas thabs dang rim gro bya/ /chu lon sngar nas ma brtsigs na/ /brubs nas 'ol ka bsgyur ba dka'/ /don med las la phod btsugs nas/ /107

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang nyid nyams byed dpa' bo min/ /chu yi nang gi gzugs brnyan la/ /mchongs pas seng ge shi dang 'dra/ /dgra bo 'dul bar 'dod na yang / /spyod tshul dal zhing 'jam par bya/ /chu skyar 'jab cing 'gro ba yis/ /nya la sogs pa 'dzin la ltos/ /gzhan phyogs 'byor ba la sdang bas/ /rang gi bsod nams nyams par zad/ /chu klung drag por mchongs pa na/ /bdag nyid 'chi yis der mi gnod/ /de bas dgra las rgyal 'dod na/ /yon tan sgrub la 'bad par bya/ /chu bo che la brgal ba'i thabs 108

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/thang nas gru gzings 'chos pa yin/ /rang las bsod nams ma nyams na/ /dgra bo kho nas mi thub ste/ /chu mig rang nyid ma bskams par/ /sa yis mnan kyang 'gog mi nus/ /dbul phyug dar rgud mtho dman kun/ /sngon spyad las kyi go rim ste/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor bsrubs pa las /ri gling khor yug rim par chags/ /mkhas pa phal cher dbul 'gyur la/ /blun po'i skye bo nor gyis phyug /rnyog ma can gyi chu bo la / / sbal lcong 'bu srin lhag par mang / /brgya yi nang nas dpa' bo dang / /109

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/stong gi nang nas mkhas pa ste/ /ma dros mtsho las chu gser dang / /rgya mtsho che las nor bu 'byung / /blo dang mi ldan skye bo yis/ /'byor ba rnyed kyang spyod mi shes/ /khyi ni skom yang chu klung la/ /hub kyis mi 'thung ldag par byed/ /rang gzhan su la'ang mi phan pa'i/ /nor de med pa nyid dang mtshungs/ /chu med sa gzhi rgya che yang /mya ngam thang zhes kun gyis 'dor/ /longs spyod spel bar 'dod pas kyang / /cung zad gtong tshul shes dgos te/ /khron chu bcus na 'phel 'gyur zhing / /110

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/bzhag na snyigs mas skam par 'gyur/ /blun rmongs 'byor ba rgya che yang / /sdug bsngal rgyu las ma 'das te/ /gser ri'i bar gyi rol mtsho rnams/ /rtag tu mun pa'i smag gis non/ /'byor ldan bsod nams gsog dgos te/ /bsod nams nyams na rgud pa sla/ /ljon shing yal ga rgya che yang /chu dang bral na skam par 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthu dang dge ba'i blo/ /phan tshun rgyur gyur skal ba bzang / /chu yis char dang char gyis chu/ /rgyas byed re mos grogs su 'gyur/ /kha bshad mang ngam nyung yang rung / /111

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dgos don lag tu blangs na go /chu zheng che chung ci 'dra yang / /zab dang mi zab brgal na shes/ /legs byas srol 'byed mkhas pa ste/ /de yi rjes su 'jug pa sla/ /cang shes rta yis rab btsal ba'i/ /phyi bzhin khyi yang 'brang bar byed/ /mkhas pa kun la snyoms ldan zhing / /phyogs re'i mig can chags sdang che/ /bum pa gang ba 'khur bar sla/ /phyed tsam gang ba yo 'khyom mang / /bsam tshad kha ru 'don pa der/ /gtad so med ces kun gyis brnyas/ /shag shag 'bab pa'i chu bo la/ /112

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/byis pa rnams kyang rgal bar byed/ /kha nyung bzhin 'dzum gnad phigs pa/ /de la kun gyis bag zon byed/ /sgra med mer gyis 'gro ba yi/ /chu klung gting mtha' dpog par dka'/ /chu la ri mo bris pa bzhin/ /sdig sems mod la 'dor bya zhing / /dge ba'i dam bca' rdo ba yi/ /ri mo bzhin du brtan par bya/ /bsam pa bzang na 'jig rten gyi/ /bya ba kun kyang chos su 'gro/ /zo chun la brten 'obs kyi chu/ /shin tu mtho ba'i ri rtser 'gro/ /gtso bor las 'bras dkon mchog la/ /113

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ —blo phugs gtad na ci bsam 'grub/ /lha yi rgyal pos char phab na/ /lo tog phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /'jig rten tshangs pa'i ral klong du/ /'khyams pa'i sarga mthar son te/ /sgrib gnyis dri ma 'khrud pa'i phyir/ /dam pa'i chos kyi lam du 'dren/ /chu rigs bdun las mchog gyur pa'i/ /chu mgo gangs la thug pa bzhin/ /chos kyang 'khrul bral ma nor ba/ /rgyal ba'i bka' las 'byung ba dgos/ /de nas zab rgyas nyams len gyi/ /lam gsum rim par 'bab pa yi/ /gdams ngag tshang la ma nor ba/ /114

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/skal bzang rnam sad mchod yon yin/ /'on kyang dus kyis cher snyigs tshe/ /'jam dbyangs bla mas gsal mdzad de/ /rgya mtshor byings pa'i rig byed bzhi/ /nya yi gzugs kyis bton pa bzhin/ /'di 'dra'i bstan dang mjal bzhin du/ /ltar snang lam la su zhig 'jug /lha yi chu bo gang gā'i rtsar/ /ba tshwa'i khron pa su zhig rko/ /blo chung skal dman zab zab kyi/ /grags pas bslus nas log par 'gro/ /smig rgyu chu ru 'khrul ba yis /ri dwags don med sdug bsngal myong / /chos kyi lam du 'jug pa la/ /115

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dang por dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ /rgya mtshor bgrod 'dod bya ba'i mgo /ded dpon mkhas pa 'tshol ba yin/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /dge legs rtsa ba bla ma ste/ /'dzam gling rtsi shing lo 'bras kun/ /ma dros mtshor gnas klu yi drin/ /nga rgyal spangs te zhi dul gyis/ /dam chos snod du rung bar bya/ /chu bo sgang du mi gnas par/ /dma' ba'i gshong du 'khyil bar 'gyur/ / chos kun cig car mi shes kyang / /ci tsam shes bzhin don du 'gyur/ /chu klung rdzogs par ma 'thungs kyang / /116

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/ci tsam btungs pas skom pa sel/ /thos mang nyams su ma blangs na/ /rang gi rgyud la mi phan te/ /chu nang lo brgyar gnas pa yi/ /rdo ba'i rang bzhin skam por gnas/ /stong rkyal goms pa'i rim pa yis/ /rtag 'ju res 'ju mi 'ju ltar/ /thos bsam sgom pa sgra spyi la/ /brten pa'i tshul yang gsum du gsungs/ /mi yi gru gzings rnyed dus 'dir/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i ba dan la/ /brten nas srid mtsho brgal bya yi/ /gru 'di phyi nas rnyed par dka'/ /rigs drug skye sgo mtha' yas kyang / /117

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dal brgyad tshang ba shin tu dkon/ /chu bo grangs med 'bab na yang / /yan lag brgyad ldan re re tsam skyes pa'i skad cig de nyid nas/ /mi sdod 'chi bdag khar phyogs te/ /chu klung skad cig re re bzhin/ /phyir mi ldog par rgya mtshor 'gro/ /mi rtag srin pos bzung bzhin du/ /sos bder sdod pa ga la rigs/ /chu srin mche ba'i phrag gnas la/ /bde ba'i go skabs nam yang med/ /bsgrubs kyang pha mthar phyin med pa'i/ /'jig rten bya ba btsan chod bya/ /chu gnyer gcig rjes gcig non de/ /118

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/ci tsam bdas kyang zin dus med/ /blo rig stobs dang rtsal che yang /dus kyi pho nyas dbang med 'ching / /chu chen rlabs kyi gar mkhan ma/ /dgun dus 'khyags pa'i sbubs su tshud/ /sgo gsum mi dge'i spyod tshul 'dis/ /phyi ma'i skye ba ngan 'gror nges/ /ri bo'i zom nas 'bab pa'i chu/ /g.yang sa brgyud mar brdab cing 'phyo/ /de nas lo grangs bye ba brgyar/ /bsregs shing 'tshed kyang 'chi mi nus/ /rdo sol ri la char gyi rgyun/ /babs pa bskal pa'i bar du khol/ /'jigs chen de las skyob pa'i skyabs/ /119

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bslu med dkon mchog gsum las med/ /chu bo'i rgyun gyis khyer ba de/ /sgrol byed mnyan pa kho nar nges/ /mchog gsum byin rlabs mtha' yas kyang / /dad pa med na ji ltar skyob/ /rgya mtsho che yang char sdod kyi/ / byi'u'i skom pa sel mi nus/ /'khor ba'i 'dam las ma brgal ba'i/ /'jig rten pa la brten mi bya/ /chus khyer chu yis khyer ba la/ /'jus na gnyis ka bying bar 'gyur/ /mchog gsum bsten na de yi khrims/ /las 'bras blang dor 'bad pa gces/ /ded dpon bsten kyang gru gzings su/ /120
