legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/mi sdod de nyid ji ltar sgrol/ /snod bcud bde sdug snang ba kun/ /'khrul med sngon bsags las las 'byung / /chu phor gang yang 'gro ba bzhir/ /snang tshul tha dad 'byung bar gsungs/ /dge dang mi dge chung ngu nas/ /bsags pas shes rgyud gang 'gyur te/ /char gyi thigs pa bsags pas kyang / /mtha' klas chu yi dkyil 'khor chags/ /gnas skabs dge ba ltar snang yang / /bsngo dang 'dun pas bslad pa mang / /mchog tu mngar ba gang gā'i chu/ /rgya mtshor 'dres na kha bar 'gyur/ /rmongs pa'i mun nag gis ldongs shing / /121

—legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/las kyi zhags pas bcings pa rnams/ /sred pa'i klung gis rab drangs te/ /mi bzad skye ba'i rgya mtshor 'gro/ /'dod pa lan tshwa'i chu bo ni/ /ci tsam spyad kyang mi ngoms pas /chu mtsho 'khyags pa'i ngang ba ltar/ /srid las nges 'byung skyo shas skyed/ /las nyon na kras yongs gang ba/ /sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol byed bslab gsum gru bo che/ /bzung nas thar pa'i gling du gshegs/ /khyad par khas blangs tshul khrims ni/ /nyes ltung dri mas ma sbags pa/ /rgya mtsho ro dang mi 'grogs ltar/ /122

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/rtag tu dran shes brtan pos srungs/ /'on kyang ma rgan sems can rnams/ /dor nas rang don byar mi 'os /rgya mtsho'i gling du gnyen bshes kun/ /'bor ba ded dpon spyod tshul min/ /mtshor gnas g.yo dang mi bden pa'i/ /khyad par gsum ldan chu zla lta'i/ /'gro la snying rje rnam gsum gyis/ /theg chen lam gyi srog rtsa tshugs/ /byang chub sems kyis zin pa'i dge /mi zad byang chen rgyur 'gro ste/ /dzam bu'i 'bras bu ma dros mtshor/ /lhung bas gser sbyangs khams su 'gyur/ /rgyal sras spyod pa mtha' klas kyang / /123

—leb/sabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/pha rol phyin pa drug tu 'du / /ri sul la lung chu bo brgya/ /zam 'og gcig tu 'dril ba bzhin/ /rgyal sras rnams ni bdog pa kun/ /'bras bcas gtong ste sbyin pa'i mchog /char gyis rtsi bcud lo tog kun/ /bskyangs kyang lan dang re ba med/ /rnam dag khrims kyis nyes ltung gi /rnyog pa ma lus drungs 'byin te/ /ke ta ka 'bras bye ma yis/ /chu bo'i rnyog ma dwangs par byed/ /dge tshogs ma lus sreg byed pa'i/ /khong khro'i dgra 'joms bzod pa ste/ /kun za 'bar ba'i me lce ni/ /124

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/gsod byed gnyen po chu yin no/ /rtag gus brtson pa ma btang na/ /mi 'grub bya ba ci yang med/ /chu thigs rtag tu 'bab pa yis/ /brag gi ri bo 'bigs la ltos/ /bying rgod skyon bral ting nge 'dzin/ /gsal bar yon tan thams cad 'char/ /be+eḍūr me long phyis 'dra ba'i/ /dwangs mtshor gzugs brnyan ci yang gsal/ /dngos kun stong par dmigs pa yis/ /'khor ba'i gdung ba kun sel te/ /chu klung mtha' dag ag s+t+yas/ /hub kyis gzhal bas bdud rtsir 'gyur/ /klu sgrub blo mtsho rgya che bas/ /125

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wad jidangos por smra rnams spobs pa phrogs/ /rngam gnag gting mtha' mi mngon pa'i/ /rgya mtshos byis pa skrag par byed/ /zab mo'i de nyid 'byed pa la/ /thog mar dgag bya nges dgos te/ /rgya mtshor nor bu len pa la/ /'jigs pa gar yod shes pa gces/ /gdags gzhi phung sogs 'dus pa la/ /nga 'o snyam du 'khrul ba ste/ /klung chen gdod nas brubs 'dra yang / /chu phran du ma 'dus pa yin/ /btags don rigs pas dpyad pa na/ /ngo bos grub pa 'ga' med de/ /chu klung yur ba brgyar drangs pa'i/ /126

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/shul na zil ba tsam yang med/ /ston pas ji snyed bka' stsal pa/ /stong dang rten 'byung 'dir 'jug ste/ /sa steng chu bo ma lus pa/ /rgya mtsho chen por gzhol zhing 'bab/ /rang rgyud smin pa'i rgyal sras kyis/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhis gdul bya skyong / /rgya mtshor 'jug myong ded dpon gyis/ /gzhan yang khrid nas nor la sbyor/ /rgyu yi theg pa'i lam ring yang / /gsang sngags thabs kyis myur du bgrod/ /thang du 'dren dka'i gru bo che/ /rgya mtshor zhugs na yud kyis 'gro/ /rdo rje can gyis legs gsungs pa'i/ /127

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa gsang sngags nus pa bsam mi khyab/ /gdung ba ma zhes bos pas kyang / /lha yi chu bo 'gugs par byed / /zung 'jug gdengs can bdag po'i gnas/ /rdo rje theg pa rgya mtsho che'i/ /'jug ngogs bde ba'i 'bab stegs ni/ /dbang bzhi'i rin chen them skas yin/ /'on kyang dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi/ /gzhi rten dam tshig sdom pa ste/ /rtsa ba chu mtsho bskams gyur na/ /rlabs kyi phreng ba gang las 'byung / /de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'dod la spyod kyang zhen pa med/ /nya ni chu gting zab mo na/ //2/shrī

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/'gyu yang chu yis 'tshub mi 'gyur/ / chags sogs nyon mongs nyes pa rnams/ /nyon mongs lam byed nyid kyis 'joms/ /rna bar chu son chus 'byin zhing / /mes tshig me yis gdungs pas zhi/ /bskyed rim phra rags rnal 'byor gyis/ /skye shi bar do gsum sbyong ste/ /skal ldan shing rta'i mchod yon gyis/ /dug can dri ma 'khrud pa bzhin/ /dga' bzhi'i lhan skyes bde ba ches/ /stong bzhi'i ye shes rgyas 'gyur te/ /chu bo rnam bzhi'i rgyun 'bab pas /rta gdong me chen 'bar bar 'gyur/ /phra ba gnyug ma'i rlung sems las /129

dgosprashadabastanasgyusaphyogs sgrigs/ — —— da —sgyu ma lta bu'i skur bzhengs pa/ /dwangs pa'i chu las chu bur dang / /dag pa'i mkha' las chu 'dzin bzhin/ /rtswa rtse'i zil ba re rer yang / /zla ba'i gzugs brnyan snang ba bzhin/ /dpe yi rim pa re res kyang / /'khor 'das chos kun mtshon par nus/ /'jig rten ya rabs spyod pa nas/ /mdo sngags lam gyi rim pa'i bar /dper bya gcig gis mtshon pa 'di/ /legs bshad 'phrul gyi rgya mtsho yin/ /longs spyod 'khor lo'i chu gter na/ /dbyangs ldan ngang mo rnam rol pa/ /de yi kha las legs bshad kyi/ /130

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/rba rlabs 'khri shing ci yang g.yo/ /gang yang bdag blo'i chu gter las 'khrungs legs bshad gsar ba'i zla ba ni/ /'jig rten rmongs pa'i mun 'phrog snying gi gdung sel bsil ba'i reg pa can/ /de yi dge ba sa gsum rnam dkar 'od kyi gos bzang 'dzin pa des/ /skye dgu'i legs byas blo dang lhan cig bstan pa'i chu gter rgyas gyur cig /ces legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos lugs gnyis rlabs phreng brgya ldan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sngar rang gi rgyud la bag chags 'jog pa'i phyir du rtsom khul gyis dus tshod la dpag pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung du bgrang rung cam kha shas bris yod na'ang / shing gi bstan bcos de dar so che zhing /mthong byed mkhan mang du 'ong bar snang bas de la 'grel ba zhig kyang byung na legs zhes/ pa ren su nyid shog nas bsngags 'os yon tan du ma'i rgyan phreng 'dzin pa nom chi zhabs drung skal bzang dar rgyas kyis yang yang nan gyis 131

— legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bskul te bri bar brtsams na yang / de'i chos kyi sarga lam rim las logs su mi dgos la/ gzhan rnams go sla ba 'ba' zhig gtsor 'don dang / dpe'ang yongs grags mkhas blun thams cad la 'char bde ba kho nar sbyar stabs de las gsal du gtong rgyu med pa lta bur snang zhing / phyogs mthun gyi khungs dpal mgon klu sgrub kyi shes rab brgya pa/ shes rab sdong bu/ skye bo gso thigs gsum dang / tsa na ka rgyal po'i lugs kyi bstan bcos/ ma su rak+ṣas byas pa'i lugs kyi bstan bcos/ nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa tshigs su bcad pa'i mdzod/mchog sred kyi tshigs bcad brgya pa/ dri ma med pa'i dris lan rin po che'i phreng ba/ sa skya'i legs bshad rnams dang / gzhan yang 'phrin yig bslab bya sogs/ de mthun rnams drangs te bshad na tshig tshogs ches lci bar 'gyur bas/'dir ljon shing chu'i khams kyis rgyas par byed pa'i dpe dang mthun par/ de nyid du ma tshang ba 'ga' zhig kha bskangs nas cung zad rgyas su btang / der mchog dman dang gtso phal gyi rim pas chos kyi sarga sngon du byas kyang /'dir gong nas gong du bgrod pa'i rim pas mjug tu byas te go rim bsdebs pa sogs don 'grel gyi tshul du byas nas/ 7 btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gtsug lag lta ba'i blo mig can gyi k+ṣu rat+na ā nan+tas bgyis pa 'di'ang /skye bo rnams la dge ba'i 'jug dogs gsal ba'i rgyur gyur cig /132

legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos/sarba kā le she yo bha ba tu/ na mo rat+na sha sa na dri pā ya/ chos srid zung du 'brel ba yi/ /ya rabs dam pa'i spyod tshul mchog /ngo mtshar dpe don mtha' yas pas/ /rab gsal lugs kyi bstan bcos 'di/ /gang zhig rnam grol gur khang du/ /'grod 'dod skal bzang gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /dang por mi chos them skas la/ /nges par brten pa gnad du che/ /de phyir u rad dbus shog gi /rab 'byams ye shes chos 'dzin gyis/ /sku 'bum gso rig grwa tshang du/ /bkod legs par du bskrun pa'i dges/ /'brel thogs lus can mtha' dag gi /blo yi mun pa rab gsal te/ /dam pa'i brtul zhugs lhur blangs nas/ /'dun ma'i yang rtser phyin gyur cig /ces shing gi bstan bcos dang chu yi bstan bcos gnyis kyi par byang smon tshig tu snyoms las mal du nyal ba'i tshangs sras dgyes pa'i blo gros kyis bris pa'o/ /133

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/༄༅/ /dam pa chos lugs kyi rin po che'i bstan bcos legs bshad dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//nom chi mkhan po ngag dbang phun tshogs/gser ri'i dbus na lhun po ni/ /rab brjid mtshungs zlas dben pa ltar/ /dgra bcom 'khor dbus mngon mdzes pa'i/ /ston pa mchog de'i zhabs skyes mchod/ /nor bu'i cod pan 'od 'phro ba/ /skabs gsum lha yi gtsug na mdzes/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mo yang / /slob ma'i gtsug gi rgyan du 'os/ /bsam 'phel dbang rgyal rgyal mtshan rtser/ /134

—da dngo/chod gsaljosprospra—ngoljotram̐rwaspudzi/—man mad dgos 'dod char du 'bebs//bshes mchog zhabs bsten bka' drin las//'di phyi'i legs tshogs yid bzhin 'grub//mtshan mo'i lam bgrod dka' tshegs che//nor bu'i snang bar brten pas bde//gsung rab bde blag rtogs pa'i ched//lam ston bshes gnyen mig ltar gces//nor bu bkru ba'i dpe gsum ltar//gdul bya'i blo kha'i rim pa la/ltos te gsung rab gong 'og snang //don du chos la bzang ngan med//dbul ṭ+wāṃ ༵ga bsngal gyis gdungs kyang //nor bu gas la yid smon byed//shes brtson nor gyis dbul na yang //

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/chos la nan tan dad gus bskyed/ /rin chen mgul rgyan 'phyang 'phrul gyis/ /mgrin pa yid 'ong byed pa bzhin/ /legs bshad gtam gyi sbyor ba ni/ /blo gsal mgrin pa'i mdzes rgyan yin/ /sna tshogs nor bu'i gter rdol ba'i/ /khyim du dbul phongs sdug bsngal bral/ /gang zhig chos la dad pa thob/ /sems la yon tan rnam mang 'dren/ /bzhin gyi nag nog dri ma de/ /nor bu'i me long ngos na gsal/ /rang sems skyon dang yon tan rnams/ /chos kyi me long nang du gsal/ /byad bzhin dngos dang de'i gzugs brnyan/ /136

legs par bshad pa rin po che'i bstan bcos/me long shar ba 'dra snang 'char/ /bcos ma'i dad dang dad pa gnyis/ /'drar snang 'char yang khyad par che/ /longs spyod don du rin po che/ /gsog sgrub byed tshe rkun ma sdang / /thos sogs yon tan don gnyer tshe/ /bag med rkun pos 'khyer nyen yod/ /sngar rnyed nor bu dor nas ni/ /phyi ma len la dga' ba yod/ /slob ma ngan pas bla ma la/ /skyon du blta zhing phyi ma btsal/ /gser gyi yon tan mi shes 'ga'/ /mig la gnod ces dor ba yod/ /deng dus skye sprul phal cher zhig /137

les/sa bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da —dge rgan khur du mthong nas 'dor/ /ji ltar sa rdo rnyed sla zhing / /rin chen mchog ni rnyed par dka'/ /bde 'gro'i ngan 'gro'i rten mang po/ /rnyed kyang dal 'byor thob pa dkon/ /shel bum re zhig longs spyad kyang / /nam zhig dus na 'jig par 'gyur/ /yun ring thabs kyis bskyang bskyangs pa'i/ /lus 'di 'jig par gdon mi za/ /rin po che dang snam bu gnyis/ /brkus la chad pas che chung ltar/ /dge sdig che chung stobs kyis ni/ /las kyi 'bras bu che chung 'byung / /mi zhig lam khar gser rnyed pas/ /138

legs par bshad pa rin po che'i bstan bcos/sdug bsngal mang po thob pa bzhin/ /'khor ba'i bde 'byor gang thob kyang / /sdug bsngal rang bzhin yid brtan med/ /lus ngan dpung ldan rgyal btsun gnyis/ /me shel nyi 'od phrad pas bsregs/ /mi dge'i las kyis ngan song na/ /sdug bsngal du mas sems can gdungs/ /rin chen me tog lha lha mo/ /phan tshun rtsed 'jo'i phyir du 'phen/ /yang sos dmyal ba'i nang phan tshun/ /khros pas gsod phyir ral gri 'phen/ /gos dang rin chen shing la sogs/ /bzo sgrub byed tshe thig 'debs ltar/ /lus la dmyal srung thig btab nas/ /139

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mtshon chas gshags pa'i tshul 'di sdug /rin chen rdo dang shing sman sogs/ /gtun du brdungs pas rab tu bcom/ /bsdus 'joms ri bos las ngan rnams/ /phye mar 'thag cing khrag klung 'bab/ /rim gcig rim gnyis gong bur bsregs/ /rin chen sman nus che chung ldang / /lcags khang rim gcig rim gnyis bsregs/ /sems la sdug bsngal che chung 'byung / /lha rnams rin chen khang bzang na/ /bdud rtsi'i khrus kyis lus kun gsher/ /khro chu'i nang na dmyal ba'i 'gro/ /gsal shing rtser bskyon khrag gis gsher/ /dge 'bras bde reg sa gzhi dang / /140

—da wa — legasasdun+d+ra rwashadaparinapo che'i bstan bcos/ri bor lha rnams bde ba myong / /sdig 'bras lcags bsregs sa gzhi dang / /ri bo sems dmyal sreg pa'i rdzas/ /rin chen mar me'i sdong bu de/ /me dang lhan cig sreg pa ltar/ /lus po me dang dbyer med 'dres/ /mi bzad dmyal ba mnar med sdug /mun par chud pa'i dong bzhin du/ /smag rim gnas pa'i gangs ri'i khrod/ /chu bur can sogs sdug bsngal dang / /tshe tshad yun ring 'jigs pa che/ /sems dpa' che rnams rin chen dang / /zas kyi char phab dug tu 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i las kyis gdungs pa yi/ /141

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ yi dwags bkres skom du mas nyen/ /dbyar dus zla dkyil shar bas sreg /dgun dus nyi dkyil shar yang 'khyag /smig rgyu chur mthong chu klung skam/ / yi dwags snang ba phyin ci log /rin chen 'byor yang klu 'ga' zhig /bye tshan dang ni mkha' lding 'joms/ /dud 'gro gzhan dbang shugs che bas/ /rang lus gzhan gyis zas su za/ /rin chen mdun du spungs na yang / /rdo dang khyad med rkang bas brdzi/ /de 'dra'i rmongs pas zil mnan pa'i/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas ya re nga / /me shel nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /142

—da wa legasaparabag ngarinapotre+enitshoskyunabacos/ grang reg 'joms pa'i nus pa snang / /bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ / ngan 'gro'i 'jigs skyob dpung gnyen che/ /rin chen sa gzhi lcags bsregs gzhi/ /lha dang dmyal ba so sor spyod/ /dge sdig las las bde sdug rnams/ /'byung tshul zhib bsam skyo bar mdzod/ /nyi dkyil mkha' la shar ba na/ /dro grang nyin srib khyad las 'byung / /rgyal ba'i thugs rje kun snyoms kyang / /'gro la bde sdug las kyis 'byung / /gser sogs rin chen sna bdun gyi/ /bang mdzod thabs kyis bsgrubs pa bzhin/ /yon tan bdun gyis nyer mdzes pa'i/ /143

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rten bzang 'thob pa'i thabhas la 'bad/ /rin chen sman gyi rdzas 'ga' la/ /zhen pa ldog kyang nad pas 'thung / /sdul bsngal las ni thar ba'i phyir/ /gnas skabs mngon mtho don du gnyer/ /rin chen sa gzhir nor bu'i ljon/ /rgyu tshogs tshang na skye ba ltar/ /rgyu brgyad dag pa gsum tshang na/ /rnam smin 'bras bu phul byung 'byin/ /mi yi dbang bo 'khor sgyur che/ /gser gyi 'khor lor dbang bsgyur yang / /nam zhig las kyi gzhan dbang gis/ /ltung ba'i tshul 'di bsams tshe skyo/ /nor bu'i 'od dang gzhal med khang / /144

legs par bshad pa rin po che'i bstan bcos/lha min longs spyod lha la 'gran/ /phrag dog dang ni g.yo sgyu yis/ /bden mthong skal med bdud kyi gnyen/ /rin chen them skas 'bab 'dzeg las/ /dma' zhing mtho ba'i go sa ltar/ /yang dang yang du rigs drug 'gro/ /mtho dman sa ru nges par skye/ /rin chen rgyan ldan lha'i bu mor/ /reg pa'i bde ba yun ring myong / /slar yang dmyal bar 'thag gcod kyi/ /reg pa mi bzad bsten dgos sdug /rkang gdub sgras kyang yid dbang 'gugs/ /lhun po'i spo la yun ring gnas/ /slar yang me mur ro myags brgal/ / 145

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa—sdug bsngal myong tshe ci zhig bya/ /rin chen khang bzang mdzes pa'i tshal/ /lha bu rnams dang rtsen brtson nas/ /slar yang ral gri'i nags tshal lhung / /rkang lag gcod 'gyur su zhig bzod/ /nor bus gang ba'i dal 'bab 'gram/ /gdong mdzes bu mor lhan cig 'grogs/ /slar yang chu bo rab med du/ /skye dgos bsam tshe yid re skyo/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang na/ /brgya byin lha rnams mchod pa'i yul/ /'di yang las kyis sa steng lhung / /'khor bar yang bran 'gyur bar gsungs/ /gser gyi sgrog gis bcings na yang / /146

da wa da wa legasaparabashad pa rin po che'i bstan bcos/mngon par dga' blo mi 'byung ltar/ /khams gong lha yi ting 'dzin sogs/ /re zhig ngal gso tsam du zad/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shar ba na/ /tsha ba'i gdung ba 'phrog par byed/ /'phags nor zhi ba'i lam bzang bsten/ /nyon mongs tsha gdung gzhil bar 'gyur/ /rin chen phal ba mang na yang / /dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu dkon/ /byang chub sems kyi rin chen 'dis/ /dge ba gzhan gang zil gyis gnon/ /sna tshogs nor bu'i phung bo rnams/ /'dren 'dod shing rta thabs su btsal/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams 'dren 'dod pas/ /147

—/legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ thogatong sems spel la rgya cher bslab/ /rin chen shing rta bsgyur 'dod tshe/ /kha lo pa zhig grogs su dgos/ /'dod pa 'bras bcas gtong 'dod na/ /zhen med 'khor gsum dag pa gces/ /chu gter nor bu'i bum pa las/ /dag byed rgyun 'bab dri ma 'khrud/ /tshul khrims gaṅgā'i rgyun bzang po/ /bsten pas nyes spyod dri ma 'khrud/ /nor gyi bye brag nyung na yang / /gser mang gyur na don gyis 'byor/ / yon tan mang po ma mchis kyang / /tshul khrims ldan na don gyis 'byor/ /nyi ma me shel phrad pa'i tshe/ /148

legs par bshad pa rin po che'i bstan bcos/sreg byed nus pa lhag par ldang / /sdug bsngal la sogs rkyen phrad tshe/ /byang sems bzod pa'i go cha bgo /rang bzhin dbyibs legs lang tsho can/ /rin chen rgyan gyis lhag par mdzes/ /snying stobs mchog gi yon tan can/ /bzod pa khyad 'phags go chas mdzes /nor bu'i mchog dman bye brag gis/ /'od kyang che chung 'byung ba ltar/ /lam bzang sgrub tshe brtson 'grus kyi/ /khyad las sa chod che chung 'byung / /brtson pa shugs drag rgyun ring bas/ /rin chen ri bo 'bigs par snang / /mi ldog brtan pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /149

da legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ —gang brtsams las kyi mtha' rnams 'grub/ /dpung ba brtan pa'i lag pa yis/ /rtse phran mu tig 'phyang 'phrul bstar/ /bying rgod skyon bral ting 'dzin gyis/ /dmigs yul mtshan dpe'i mdzes sdug bzo/ /nor bu bzhu blugs byed pa na/ /rdzas kyi rten 'brel tshang ba dgos/ /rnam dag ting 'dzin 'grub 'dod pas/ /yan lag rgyu tshogs tshang bar 'bad/ /brtson pas rab tu brdar ba yi/ /rin chen ral gris 'khri shing gcod/ /yang yang sbyangs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /rmongs pa'i dra ba gcod par byed/ /dmigs bu med na dmus long rnams/ /150

legs par bshad pa rin po che'i bstan bcos/rin chen grong khyer ga la bgrod/ /gang tshe shes rab mig med na/ /sbyin sogs dmus long 'dra bar gsungs/ /nor bu dgra bo'i dpung 'joms sogs/ /nyer mkho chags med sbyin pa ltar/ /gzhan bde mchog la sbyor 'dod pas/ /rang gi bde ba rtswa ltar 'dor/ /mtho dman gang yang dga' skyed rdzas/ /rin po che las gzhan na gang / /snyan smra gtso bo legs bshad smra/ /gang phan tshig sbyor tshul mkhas yin/ /rin chen sbyin na dga' lags te/ /ster ba'i tshig tsam de lta min/ /don spyod bzang por snying nas 'jug /151

— legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kha bshad tsam gyis mthar mi phyin/ /nor bu spyin pa'i ded dpon mthong / /thams cad de la yid smon byed/ /don mthun rang gis spyad byas na/ /gzhan dag de yi rjes su 'jug /bi shwa karmas lha dang mi'i/ /rin chen las grub mdzes sku bzhengs/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo chen gyis/ /rang sems sku bzhi'i sa bon bskrun/ /nor bu'i snod du gzung 'os pa'i/ /chu gtsang lus kyi dri ma 'khrud/ /rnam dag dbang bzhi'i rgyun bzang gis/ /sgo gsum sgrib pa'i dri ma 'khrud/ /nor bu'i bye brag khyad par gyis/ /152

legs par bshad pa rin po che'i bstan bcos/yon tan bzang ngan shes pa dkon/ / cagasang sngags mchog gi gdul bya yang / /dpe yi khyad par du ma bcas/ /rgyal po dga' bar bya 'dod pas/ /rin chen phul ba thabs su bzang / /yi dam lha tshogs mnyes byed na/ /dam tshig bsrung ba'i tshogs bsags 'bad/ /mun sel 'dzam gling snang ba'i 'od/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar bas 'ong / /skye shi bar do sbyong ba'i lam/ /gnad smin bskyed rim stobs las 'byung / /sna tshogs nor bu'i 'od zer gyis/ /rtse dga' dgod pa'i ngo mtshar ltar/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /153

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/spro dang bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor bya/ /lha dbang brgya byin gzugs brnyan ni/ /baiḍūr dwangs ma'i gzhi la 'char /ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa yi/ /'ja' tshon lha sku yid ngor bzhengs/ /kha dog sna lnga'i nor bu'i 'od/ /rnam pa'i khyad par nyams spro skyed/ /rigs lnga yab yum rnam 'gyur gyi/ /khyad las bde dga' lhag par 'dren/ /rta bdun dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba/ /skya rengs snang bas 'dzum gyis bsu/ /rdzogs rim zab mo'i rnal 'byor bde/ /phyag rgya'i 'phrul 'degs stobs kyis 'dren/ /rin chen rgyan gyi gdub kor de/ //54

legs par bshad pa rin po che'i bstan bcos/chags ldan yid dbang 'gugs pa'i thabs/ /rdo rje slob dpon sras bcas mchod/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'gugs pa'i rgyu/ /ji lta nor bu ke ta kas/ /rnyog ma'i chu bo dwangs par byed/ /sgru tir 'bar 'dzags las byung ba'i/ /dga' bdes sems kyi sgrib rnyog grungs/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi yi/ /zegs ma 'bum 'dzag kun da bzhad/ /byang sems dbu mar bzhugs pa las/ /lhan skyes bde chen dga' ston bzhad/ /chu shel dbang bo'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bcu drug cha yis 'phel ba snang / /dpyid kyi thig le rgyas pa'i dpal/ /155

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dga' ba'i lang tsho bcu drug ngom/ /gang zhig rgya mtshor gru gzings bsdams/ /rin chen gling nas nor bu 'dren/ /de bzhin dam tshig bsrung ba dang / /rgyud sde'i gdams ngag len 'dod bskyed/ /ded dpon yid bzhin nor bu len/ /don mthun rgya mtsho'i 'jigs las sgrol/ /slob dpon legs bshad nor bu 'dren/ /gdul bya srid mtsho che las sgrol/ /gser bzang mdzes pa'i ka la sha'i/ /rgyun bzang lus kyi dri ma 'khrud/ /bum dbang gaṅgā'i klung chen rgyun/ /tha mal snang zhen dri ma sbyong / /rin chen phra ldem ljon pa can/ /156

legs par bshad pa rin po che'i bstan bcos/pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur bung bas spyod/ /zab gsang a mṛ ta yi khams/ /bla ma'i man ngag stobs las myang / /rin chen nyi 'od dang 'grogs pas/ /pad+mor sbrang rtsi'i phung bo rgyas/ /spu long g.yo ba'i zlos gar can/ /phyag rgya'i pad+ma ma'i bcud len bsngags/ /baiḍūr dag pa'i me long du/ /gzugs brnyan bye ba 'gog med 'char/ /bde chen rang bzhin dga' ba'i dngos/ /dag pa'i brtan g.yo ci yang 'char/ /nyi ma me shel khams gcig las/ /phyogs bcur 'od zer kun tu 'gyed/ /rgyal ba sprul gzhi longs spyod rdzogs/ /157

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ngo mtshar sprul sku ther 'bum 'gyed/ /rin chen snying bo dag pa ltar/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rnam par dag /rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' klas pa'i/ /brjod bya'i rang bzhin rnam par dag /nor bu rang bzhin skye ba med/ /'gegs med gnas pa med pa ste/ /'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kyang / /de ltar rang bzhin nyid kyis stongs/ /ded dpon mchog gyur sbyin la dga'/ /nor bus 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong / /stobs bcu mnga' ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la bdud rtsi'i gter chen 'gyed/ /rgya mtsho chen po chu yi gter/ /158

legs par bshad pa rin po che'i bstan bcos/nor bu'i 'byung gnas chen por grub/ /thub pa'i gsung rab bdud rtsi'i gter/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas che ru grub/ /bum pa bzang po rin chen snod/ /'gro ba'i re skong 'dod 'jo'i dpal/ /gdams pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal/ /'jam mgon legs bshad khyad par 'phags/ /'byor ldan rin chen spel 'dod pas/ /ded dpon rjes su zhugs pa ltar/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams thob 'dod na/ /slob dpon rjes su 'jug par bya/ /rin po che yi rgyan brgyad po/ /yid 'phrog lha yi rdzas su 'dra/ /'dir ni mtshungs gsal sogs bkod pa'i/ /159

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gdams ngag 'gro la sman pa'i thabs/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu yis/ / tshe 'di'i re ba kun skong ltar/ /'di sbyar dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro'i/ /phan bde'i re ba kun skong shog /ces dam pa chos lugs kyi rin po che'i bstan bcos legs bshad dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mtsho sngon a ton tis sngon nas skyo sangs nyin la byas skabs/ nom chi mkhan po ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis rab rgyal sa yos lor sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ dad ldan sbyin bdag su rug dge slong blo bzang 'od zer rgya mtsho dang sa sor ḍā ki gnyis kyis mthun rkyen sbyar te/rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa sbrul lor yang bskyar par du bskrun pa'o/ /160

legs par bshad pa me'i bstan bcos/༄7/ /dam pa chos lugs kyi me'i bstan bcos thar lam gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// nom tshi mkhan po/ye shes 'od kyi snang ba yis/ /ma rig mun pa sel mdzad pa/ /thub pa sgron me rnams la 'dud/ /thugs rjes 'gro kun rjes su zungs/ /snum gyis rab bzung sdong bu las/ /me yi 'od zer mched pa bzhin/ /dad pa brtan na de'i rgyud la/ /chos kyi snang ba rgyas par 'gyur/ /rin chen sgron ma bsten byas na/ /161

da leshasabashadabastan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ —mun pa sel zhing snang ba gsal/ /de bzhin dam pa'i bshes bsten na/ /gti mug mun sel shes rab gsal/ / mun 'thib byung tshe sgron me sbar/ / 'od la brten nas gang 'dod rtsom/ /mi shes skabs su bshes gnyen bsten/ / de nas thos bsam gang 'dod rtsom/ /sgron me'i 'od ni ches gsal yang /long ba rnams la phan mi 'gyur/ /bshes gnyen nyi ma gsal gyur kyang / /dad brtson mig bral ci ste phan/ /snang gsal ldan na mtshan mo yang / /mi dag dga' bzhin bya ba byed/ /dam pa'i mgon dang bcas pa'i skabs/ /162

legs par bshad pa me'i bstan bcos/chos bzhin spyod la dga' bar bya /sgron me'i sdong bu btsugs pa de/ / bcos bskyar mang na 'gyel ba'i rgyu/ /dad pa gsar skyes sdig grogs kyis/ /bsgyur ba mang na 'gyur ba'i rgyu/ /mun par chud ba'i sems can las/ /nor bu'i sgron thogs lus can nyung / /'gro drug gnas na rten mang yang /dal 'byor thob pa'i lus rten dkon/ /snang gsal mig bcas 'phral yun gyi/ /bya ba kun la don dang bcas/ /dal 'byor tshang na rten de yis/ /mngon mtho nges legs don chen 'grub/ /rlung chen ldang ba'i sar bzhag pa'i/ /163

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mar me yun ring gnas mi 'gyur/ /'chi rkyen mi 'gyur dkon pa'i khrod/ /tshe srog 'di ni 'jig par sla/ /mar khu'i mang nyung a lo ke /gnas yun ring thung de la brtag /tshe srog yun ring gnas mi gnas/ /sngon gyi las dang rkyen la brten/ /ji tsam ring yang tshe srog ni/ /bsod nams tshad bzhin de tsam ste/ /snang 'od gnas yun dpyad pa na/ /snod kyi tshad bzhin de tsam mo/ /snum dang me yis rkyen byas nas/ /mar me'i sdong bu rnam par sreg /las nyon dbang gis dmyal ba'i 'gro/ /164

legs par bshad pa me'i bstan bcos/bzod dka'i tsha grang gdung bas gzir/ /sdong bu'i khong nas me 'bar tshe/ /du ba tshil tshil tsha tsha 'phro/ /yi dwags byol song ma rungs rnams/ /lus las me stag rnag khrag 'byung / /mun pa'i dpung gis mi brdzi ba/ /snang byed sgron ma bsten pas 'ong / /ngan 'gro'i mun par mi ltung ba'i/ /thabs la mchog gsum rin chen bsten/ /'od la bsten na snang ba ste/ /snang ba ma bsten mun par 'jug /dge dang sdig pa'i las 'bras kyis/ /bde 'gro ngan 'gro so sor snang / /rmongs pas zil mnan skye bo rnams/ /165

da legasabashad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa mdzes pa'i gzugs la chags pas 'phung / /mun khrod gnas pa'i phye ma leb/ /sgron me mthong bas sreg la ltos/ /mig ldan mar me yod pa yis/ /gzugs rnams mthong ba ji bzhin du/ /dge sdig las rnams thos pa yis/ /shes par gsungs pas blang dor bya/ /ji ltar snum ni ma zad bar/ /mar me sdong bu me yis sreg /de bzhin las ni ma zad bar/ /'gro lnga sdug bsngal me yis gdung / /snang gsal 'od kyis yongs bzung ba'i/ /gnas de 'bad pas bsten pa ltar/ /thar pa'i khang bzang nyams dga' ba/ /166

legs par bshad pa me'i bstan bcos/bsten phyir bslab gsum byi dor 'tshal/ /byang chub sems kyi rtsi mar de/ /mkhyen mchog sgron ma 'bar ba'i rgyu/ /de phyir rin chen sems mchog de/ /thob pa'i thabs dang mi gtong gces/ /phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i sgron 'od kyis/ /'gro la phan bde'i snang ba ster/ /blo mchog rnams kyi spyod pa la/ /dga' bzhin 'jug pa e ma rmad/ /ji ltar rlung med mar me ni/ /mi g.yo snang 'od gzugs rnam gsal/ /bying rgod skyon bral zhi gnas brtan/ /sems la dbang bsgyur mngon shes gsal/ /mtshan mo mun pa sel 'dod pas/ /167

le shas bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sgron me'i 'od bsten thabs su bzang / /ma rig mun pa sel 'dod pas/ /de nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab btsal/ /tshil bu sdong bu zung 'brel ba'i/ /me yis mun pa sel ba ltar/ /thabs shes zung du 'brel ba yi/ /lam gyis srid zhi'i rgud pa sel/ /mar me skad cig dang po tsam/ /phrad pas sreg min de med min/ /zhes sogs dpe bzhin tshogs gnyis lam/ /yang yang bsten pas sangs rgyas 'grub/ /lan cig sgron me sbar legs na/ /de nas ngang gis 'bar bar 'gyur/ /dbang yang lan cig thob legs na/ /168

legs par bshad pa me'i bstan bcos/sa lam rtogs pa bde blag 'dren/ /gsal byed yun ring gnas 'dod na/ /sdong bu'i yu ba brtan pa gces/ /gsang sngags dngos grub 'phel rgyas 'dod/ /rtsa ba dam tshig brtan la rag / lo stong gnas pa'i mun pa de/ /mar me gcig gis sel ba ltar/ /bskal brgyar bsags pa'i sdig ltung yang / /gsang sngags rgyal po gcig gis 'joms/ /mar me'i snang ba 'dod pa na/ /de yi rgyu tshogs tshang la 'bad/ /bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs 'dod pas/ /tshogs gyi zhing la nan tan 'bad/ /ji ltar mar me rang 'od dang / /169

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dbyer med mun pa 'joms pa bzhin/ /chos nyid rang sems ro gcig par/ /ye shes tshogs rdzogs chos skur bslab/ /mar me rlung skyod shel kong du/ / bzhag pas g.yo bar mi nus bzhin/ /bar chad mtshan ma byung ba'i tshe/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa gnad/ /khong khro bral yang mar me yis/ /phye leb skad cig sreg par byed/ /rwa gur me dpung 'bar ba la/ /gnod sems med kyang bgegs rnams 'joms /dri bral baiḍūr+ya yi gzhir/ /rin chen sgron me'i gzugs kun snang / /ma dag dri ma sbyangs pa'i zhing / /170

legs par bshad pa me'i bstan bcos/dag pa'i rten dang brten bcas 'char/ /dag cing gsal ba'i sgron ma mchog /dbyibs legs bkrag mdang mtshar ba bzhin/ /rgyu 'bras rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku/ /gsal rdzogs longs sprul rnam pa can/ /sgron me gcig kyang de'i gzugs brnyan/ /shel kong gcig las du mar 'char/ /sems kyi rol ba gcig la yang /gzung rnam lha sku du ma 'char/ /snang gsal rin chen 'od zer ni/ /rab yangs bar snang rtse dga' dgod/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /gzhan don phun tshogs nye bar bsgrub/ /mun pa mi 'dod snang ba 'dod/ /

da legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de yis sgron me bsten pa ltar/ /tha mal snang zhen sbyong 'dod na/ /bskyed rim nga rgyal gsal snang bslab/ /ji ltar mar mes mun pa 'joms/ /'od kyis snang ba rgyas par byed/ /dpal ldan rdo rje skur bsgoms pas/ / mi shes kun zhi legs tshogs 'phel/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal lta bu'i steng / /mar me'i phreng ba bsgrigs pa bzhin/ /snying kar gzungs kyis bskor ba la/ /yengs med brtson pas bzlas pa bya/ /rkong bu chung yang lha sku'i mdun/ /mar me yun ring bzung ba yod/ /de bzhin lha yi byin rlabs zhugs/ /172

legs par bshad pa me'i bstan bcos/tshe dpal tshul khrims yun ring gnas/ /nyi mas kha bad sgron mes mun/ /byin zas bud shing 'joms pa bzhin/ / bar chad nad gdon sdig sgrib rnams/ /bzlas brjod brtson byas myur du 'joms/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes che/ /lha sngags ting 'dzin rdzas kyis dpag /mar me la yang rang pra dang / /gzhan pra sna tshogs thabs kyis 'bebs/ /ji ltar snang byed 'od phreng dkrigs/ /mi rnams bya byed du ma 'byung / /lha yi byin rlabs dga' ston 'bar/ /rab 'byams 'phrin las dngos grub rnyed/ /glog 'od mar me chu bur rnams/ /173

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rkyen dang 'phrad na glo bur 'byung / /de bzhin dngos grub rim pa yang / /nyams len brtson pas nye bar 'byung / /mar me 'gal rkyen bral ba dang / /mthun rkyen tshogs pas 'od rab 'bar/ /rdzogs rim rtogs pa skyed 'dod na/ /nye rgyu'i sngon 'gro gnad smin 'bad/ /glog sgron nyi zla nor bu las/ /gzugs rnams snang ba'i dpe bzhin du/ /gzhi yi dus na rags pa lnga'i/ /dran sogs yul lnga gsal bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar mar me yal ba na/ /de yi 'od kyang mi snang ltar/ /gnyis snang spros ba thim pa'i skabs/ /174

legasaparabashadapame'igan ban / —rags pa'i snang ba yongs su bsdu/ /mar me shel dkar khang bzang du/ /bzhag pas phyi bltas nang gsal 'byung / /rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi ldan lus/ /phyi bltas nang gsal tshul du bskyed/ /chu shing rgya skyegs til mar mes /dbyibs sogs mtshon pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /khyad chos gsum ldan rtsa dbu ma/ /lus kyi nang du nye bar dpag /mar me shel gyi bu gar bzhag /de yi khung bu ci yod snang / /rang sems thig le 'od phrom pas /rtsa lam sbyangs pas bu ga gsal/ /ji ltar mun pas khebs pa'i gzhi/ /175

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mar me'i 'od kyis snang bar sgyur/ /lte ba'i dmar ser 'od phung gis/ /snod bcud sbyangs bsgyur dmigs pa bya/ /ji ltar mar me 'bar ba yi /mjug tu 'od kyi phung bo bsdu/ /rang lus lha skur gsal ba yang / /rjes gzhig rnal 'byor rim pas bsdu/ /mar me'i sdong bu gyen du 'bar/ /bzhus pa'i thigs pa thur du 'bab/ /gyen du 'bar ba'i tsaṇ+ḍa līs/ /spyi bo'i hūṃ yig thur du bzhu/ /sgron 'od gsal bas kun dga' bskyed/ /reg bya tsha bas bsreg bya sreg /gtum mo'i ye shes bde dga' skyed/ /176

legs par bshad pa me'i bstan bcos/kun rtog tshang tshing ci yang sreg /mar me rang bzhin stong ba ltar/ /chos kun gdod nas stongs pa ste/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i dbu ma'i lam /mdo sngags gnyis kar sgron ltar gces/ /mar me rtog med 'od gsal ba/ /rang bzhin stong ba ji bzhin du/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal zhing / /rtog med ngo bo nyid kyis stongs/ /mar me las ni snang ba 'byung / /snang bas nyams spro'i bya ba 'phel/ /phyag rgyar gzhol bas lhan skyes bde/ /lhan skyes las kyang ye shes 'dren/ /zla ba chu snod sgron me'i 'od/ /177

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/shel phreng rdog po so sor 'char /'od gsal bde chen skur bzhengs pas/ /sprul sku'i rnam rol du ma 'char/ /ji ltar snum las byung ba'i mes/ /snum ni za bar byed pa ltar/ /'dod chags las byung ye shes mes/ /'dod chags nyes pa zhi bar byed/ /su zhig nor bu'i sgron ma thogs/ /snang ba dam pas kun dga' skyed/ /gang zhig sgyu lus rin chen rnyed/ / tshe 'di'i sangs rgyas bde blag 'grub/ /mar me'i gzugs dang de'i gzugs brnyan/ /gnyis ka rang 'od dbyer mi phyed/ /zung 'jug bde chen chos kyi sku/ /178

legs par bshad pa me'i bstan bcos/yul dang yul can dbyer mi phyed/ /mar me la sogs me long 'phrad/ /rtsol rtog med par gzugs brnyan 'char/ /chos kun dri med ye shes ngor/ /rtog med ma 'dres so sor 'char/ /sgron me'i 'od zer 'bar ba las/ /kun yid snang ba'i dpal gyis tshim/ /rgyal gsung bdud rtsi yongs la spros/ /gdul bya'i khams rnams tshim par byed/ /mar me shel dang phrad pa na/ /'bad rtsol med par gzugs brnyan 'byung / /rtog med 'dod dgur 'char bzod ba'i/ /rgyal ba'i phrin las rmad du byung / /sgron me 'od kyi rang bzhin la/ /179

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mun pa btsal yang rnyed mi 'gyur/ /mthar thug don dam chos kyi sku/ /skyon dang bcas pa dmigs mi 'gyur/ /mar me las ni 'od zer dang / / 'od las gzugs rnams snang ba ltar/ /tshogs gnyis zung 'jug chos sku skyed/ /chos sku 'gro ba'i don yang spyod/ /bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bzung ste/ /zung 'jug mchog gi yon tan bar/ /sgron me gcig gi dper mtshon pa'i/ /bstan bcos 'di ni gus pas zungs/ /ye shes sgron ma 'bar ba'i bdag /thub pa mi yi sgron ma rnams/ /'jig rten sgron mar byon pa'i tshe/ /180

legs par bshad pa me'i bstan bcos/lung bstan sgron ma mchog rnyed shog /'di sbyar dge ba'i phung bo yi/ /chos kyi sgron ma gang mchis des/ /'gro kun ma rig mun pa sangs /kun mkhyen 'od zer 'gyed gyur cig /ces dam pa chos lugs kyi me'i bstan bcos sgron me kho na la sbyar ba thar lam gsal ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bdag dang skal ba mnyam pa'i thar 'dod spyi dang / rang gi slob bu'i tshogs la phan phyir mtsho sngon twes mo bkra shis bde ster ma'i ri 'gram du/ rab rgyal sa yos lor/ nom chi mkhan ming pas sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ dad ldan sbyin bdag su rug dge slong blo bzang 'od zer rgya mtshos mthun rkyen sbyar te/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa sbrul lor yang bskyar phun tshogs chos gling nas par du bskrun pa'o//bkra shis/181

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ —༄7/ /dam pa chos lugs kyi lcags kyi bstan bcos legs bshad dgos 'dod 'gugs pa'i lcags kyo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//nom chi mkhan po/mkhyen pa'i ye shes chos kun gzigs/ /brtse ba'i thugs rjes 'gro kun skyong / /'phrin las nus pa'i gnam lcags 'bar/ /bdud sde 'joms mdzad der phyag 'tshal/ /rang sems dad pa skyes pa'i tshe /bla ma'i byin rlabs bde blag 'jug /'dren byar a long ldan gyur na/ /'dren byed lcags kyu'i bya ba sla/ /lcags kyi rin dang gser gyi rin/ /182

legs par bshad pa lcags kyi bstan bcos/zong du bsgrubs na khyad che ltar/ /'jig rten don las chos gtso bor/ /bsgrubs pas don chen 'bras bu 'byung / /me yis dros tsam byas pa yi/ /lcags la ngar ni cher mi 'byung / /legs bshad cung zad thos tsam gyis/ /sems la dad pa gting skyes dka'/ /me 'od 'bar ba'i ral gri ni/ /min yang bzung bas dgra 'joms ltar/ /mtshan nyid kun ldan ma yin yang / /bla ma bsten pas nyes tshogs zhi/ /tho ba nam mkhar 'degs pa na/ /lci yang lag pas 'jal bar byed/ /rgyal ba'i gsung mchog legs bshad la/ /183

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ phra zhib rig pas brtag dpyad bya/ /ji ltar rdo la gser dang zangs/ /lcags sogs 'byung ba'i rigs 'ga' snang / /gdul bya chos la zhugs pa las /theg pa gsum gyi rigs can 'byung / /rno yang khab la bu ga med/ /skud pa rjes su 'dren mi nus/ /blo ldan snying rje med pa na/ /gdul bya rjes su 'khrid mi nus/ /khab lam drangs pa'i skud pa de/ /ci nas drang bo 'ong ba ltar/ /bsten sa'i bshes gnyen ma nor na/ /blo kha rim gyis bde bar bkri/ /rdo dang lcags gnyis phrad pa na/ /184

legs par bshad pa lcags kyi bstan bcos/me stag 'byung ba shin tu sla/ /dad brtson tshogs pa'i bla slob zung / /yon tan skye bar the tshom med/ /sra brtan lcags kyi pha bong de/ /thur 'dren sla yang gyen 'dren dka'/ /skal ngan blo kha 'jig rten la/ /bsgyur ba sla yang chos la dka'/ /lcags kyi gdung ma sbom na yang / /brtson pas brdar bas rim gyis gcod/ /mi shes dra ba dpung mthug kyang / /thos la brtson pas rim gyis gzhom/ /rdo dang lcags la phyag 'tshal bas/ / byin rlabs zhugs pa'i lo rgyus yod/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs che chung yang / /185

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang sems dad pa'i stobs la rag /lcags kyi sla nga ches sra yang / /nam zhig gas chag 'byung ngam 'jig /thob dka' 'dzam gling mi yi lus/ /re zhig gnas kyang 'jig par 'gyur/ /ji ltar lcags ni ches mang yang / /rang byung lcags kyi sku gzugs dkon/ /de bzhin 'jig rten brgya lam na/ /dal 'byor rten thob srid mtha' tsam/ /ji ltar bzo bo'i 'du byed las/ /lcags la rgyal ba'i snang brnyan bskrun/ /las kyi bzo bos bsgrubs pa'i rten/ /'di phyi'i don chen 'grub pa'i gzhi/ /dmyal ba me stag lcags bsregs 'bar/ /186

legs par bshad pa lcags kyi bstan bcos/yi dwags khro chu rnag khrag 'thung / /dud 'gro lha mi mtshon chas gshags/ /'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ /lcags kyi khri mun chud pa 'ga'/ /skyabs 'gro'i sgras kyang thar ba yod/ / de phyir ya nga'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /bslu med skyabs gnas btsal re ran/ /lcags kyi thu lum nang du yang / /ngan 'gro'i lus ni 'byung ba srid/ /las kyi rnam smin bsam mi khyab/ /de phyir dge sdig blang dor mdzod/ /lcags kyi khron pa 'bar ba'i nang / /'dug par mi bzod skyo ba 'byung / /'khor ba'i btson ra las thar ba'i /187

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ zhi ba'i khang bzang snyeg 'dod skyed/ /ji ltar gser 'gyur rtsi yis ni/ /lcags ni gser du sgyur bar byed/ /byang chub sems kyis rang gi sems/ /rin chen rin thang bral bar bsgyur/ /gtong ba'i sems ni goms pa las/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs 'gyur/ /ral gri yang yang brdar ba las/ /rno ngar spu gri'i bdag nyid thob/ /tshul khrims ldan pa'i gang zag gi /snyan grags lha yis sgrog par byed/ /au ḍi bi sha'i lcags de yi/ /yon tan rgyal rigs kha na sgrog /gzhan gyis brdzi bar mi nus pa'i/ /188

— legasaparabashad pa lcags kyi bstan bcos/rgyan mchog bzod pa dam pa ste/ /lcags kyi go khrab bzang po de/ /g.yul ngor rang srung mchog tu 'dzin/ /le lo spangs pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /legs lam gang brtsams mthar thon byed/ /lcags kyi rkang stegs 'khrul spyad la/ /brten pas thang chen myur bar bgrod/ /'phro rgod g.yeng bas sems stor yang / /ting nge 'dzin gyis slar yang sdud/ /khab len rdo dang phrad pa na/ / lcags bye dbang med 'dren la ltos/ /zab mo nges pa'i shes rab kyis/ /rtag chad g.yang sa kun las sgrol/ /ral gri'i rigs sngags grub rnams dang / /189

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mkha' lding stobs ldan 'phur la ltos/ /bsdu bzhis sems can tshim 'dod pas/ /mkho ba sbyin pa thog mar gces/ /sbyin rdzas khab skud tsam gyis kyang / /sbyin yul spro dga' lhag par 'dren/ /snyan smra dbyangs kyi bdud rtsi 'dis/ /sems ni mngon phyogs tshim par byed/ /'dod ldan skye bo'i rna lam na/ /lcags zangs gling bu a re snyan/ /gdul bya'i don spyod la zhugs tshe/ /dga' dang phan tshun 'gran bzhin dgos/ /gser dngul 'dren 'dod shing rta la/ /lcags kyi gzer mig zung 'brel gces/ /rgyu la don mthun nyer spyad pas/ /190

legs par bshad pa lcags kyi bstan bcos/'bras bu'ang don mthun phum sum tshogs/ /mtshon cha sgrub skabs brdungs legs na/ /grub zin 'od dang rno ngar 'bar /lcags la ri mo 'bri ba na/ /mig gsal dpung ba brtan pa dgos/ /mnyam gzhag skyong na gsal cha dang / /gnas cha brtan po'i ting 'dzin dgos/ /stobs ldan lag pas rab bzung ba'i/ /rno ngar ral gris 'khri shing gcod/ /zhi gnas brtan pa'i shes rab kyi/ /ral gris mthar 'dzin dra ba gcod/ / rab dwangs lcags la byad bzhin 'char/ /de nges stong yang snang tsam 'byung / /chos kun bden pas stongs pa la/ /191

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ —tha snyad bsnyon med sgyu mar 'char/ /mi yi dbang bo 'khor sgyur gyi/ /'khor lo'i dbye ba rigs bzhi 'byung / /theg pa la yang nyan rang dang / /byang sems rdo rje theg par dbye/ /shing mda' lcags kyi mde'u la/ /sprod pa don la dgos pa bzhin/ /nyan rang rnams kyang theg chen gyi/ /lam la nam zhig 'dzud par 'ong / /lcags kyi steng du rno bsnan pas/ /byed las nus pa lhag par ldang / /mdo la sngags kyi snon pa btab/ /bde blag sangs rgyas go 'phang rnyed/ /lha khang bzhengs 'dod sa gzhi de/ /192

legs par bshad pa lcags kyi bstan bcos/'jor gyis phyogs bzhir ngos mnyam gces/ /bskyed rdzogs rtogs pa bskyed 'dod pas/ /thog mar dbang bzhi gnad smin gces/ /tshogs la mang jas mchod 'dod pas/ /thog mar sla nga chen po 'dzugs/ /rgya chen bsod nams bsags 'dod na/ /mchod yul tshogs zhing phul du byung / / lcags kyi mda' char phab pa na/ /dgra sde'i g.yul ngo thal bar byed/ /gur khang me ri mda'i dra bas/ /bar chad bgegs rnams gzhom par byed/ /ji ltar lcags kyi go khrab mchog /gyon pas g.yul las rgyal bar byed/ /lha yi rnal 'byor go cha dang / /193

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/stong nyid srung ba bla na med/ /me yis bzhus pa'i lcags kyi khams/ /'od du 'bar ba'i snang ba 'char /tha mal 'chi ba'i mun pa yang /rang ngo shes pas chos skur grol/ /lcags khams gser du bsgyur ba na/ /rnam pa yid 'ong 'dzin pa bzhin/ /ma dag bar do longs sku ru/ /bsgyur bas mtshan dpe'i mdzes sdug bkra/ /lcags khams dri ma sbyong 'dod na/ /gser 'gyur byug pa'i rtsi sman bzang / /ma dag skye ba sbyong ba la/ /sprul sku'i lam 'khyer las lhag gang / /gser dngul zangs lcag/sa 'khor lo la/ /194

legs par bshad pa lcags kyi bstan bcos/'khor sgyur gnas pa'i dpe bzhin du/ /rin chen 'od 'phro gzhal med khang / /spro bsdu'i 'byung gnas lha yi gzhi/ /me 'od 'bar ba'i ral gri mchog /mun pa sel zhing dgra rnams 'joms /bdag med ting 'dzin rnal 'byor skyong / /bdag 'dzin gdon tshogs bcas pa gzhom/ /gnam lcags 'khor lo 'phangs pa na/ /pha rol dgra sde tshar gcod byed/ /gtor ma la sogs las rim mes/ /bar chad bdud kyi tshang tshing sreg /gnam ru mchog la lcags mda' sbyar/ /gang 'dod 'phen la gzas pa ltar/ /bskyed rim phra rags bsgom pa ni/ /195

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rdzogs rim rtogs pa skye ba'i ched/ /ji ltar lcags la ri mo ni/ /mgar ba mkhas pas gsal bar bzo/ /rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa khams la/ /'dod lha yab yum mdzes gzugs 'god/ /mgar ba mkhas pa'i ngag mnyan nas/ /rno lcags 'khrul 'khor bslab pa bzhin/ /lam 'di skyong mkhas tshad ldan ngag /nyan te lus kyi 'khrul 'khor sbyang / /spu gri rnon po gcig gis kyang / /skra lo brgya phrag dus gcig 'bebs/ /thabs lam zab mo'i rnal 'byor mes/ /grangs med bskal pa'i tshogs chen sdud/ /lcags mda' myur ba'i shugs thob pa/ /196

legs par bshad pa lcags kyi bstan bcos/gnam ru'i rgyud la phrad pa dgos/ /nye lam sngags gyi sa chod che/ /mtshan ldan phyag rgya'i stobs las 'ong / /me lcags mu zi'i rgyu rkyen tshogs/ /mtshon cha me 'od can du 'byung / /phyi nang thabs kyi bya ba las /'od gsal sgyu ma'i lha skur ldang / /rno ngar ldan pa'i lcags kyi mda'/ /'ben gyi gting la thug pa ltar/ /chos nyid mngon gzugs ye shes kyis/ /yul gyi gnas tshul ji bzhin gzigs/ /lcags la ngar ni thebs 'dod na/ /chu la bcug ste bzhag pas phan/ /rnal 'byor bogs 'byin spyod pa yang /197

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ri dwags bshor ba sogs kyis phan/ /gsal dwangs lcags las gzugs brnyan gyi/ /snang ba sna tshogs 'char ba bzhin/ /gang 'dul sgyu ma'i rol gar las/ /snang ba sna tshogs gdul byar 'char /lcags kyi ri dang rdo rje mchog /lag pas gzhom par ga la nus/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i rdo rje'i sku/ /'chi bdud kyis ni gzhom mi nus/ /lcags mda' myur shugs ngar ba'i skabs/ /lag pas 'dzin par mi nus bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las gang 'dod 'char/ /yid srubs dag gis 'gog mi nus/ /mgar ba'i bzo 'phrul bde blag tu/ /198

legs par bshad pa lcags kyi bstan bcos/lcags la rgyal ba'i snang brnyan 'grub/ /rnyed dka'i nye lam theg pa 'dis/ /mi tshe gcig la sangs rgyas ster/ /ral gri'i stobs kyis dgra las rgyal/ /ral gri mgar ba'i drin las byung / /thub pa'i legs bshad rmad byung rnams/ /thams cad bla ma'i drin las byung / /dgra rkun mang sar nor las kyang / /go khrab mtshon char gces spras dgos/ /snyigs dus rkyen ngan ru 'dzings skabs/ /byi dor sems la bya ba gces/ /'dir yang bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas/ /zung 'jug ye shes 'phrin las bar /lcags kyi dpe yis mtshon par byas/ /199

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/blo ldan bstan bcos gus pas zungs/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdud kyi sde/ /gnam lcags babs pa'i me tog bzhin/ /pham par byas te mtha' yas 'gro/ /byang chub mchog la 'god par shog /ces pa dam pa chos lugs kyi lcags kyi bstan bcos legs bshad dgos 'dod 'gugs pa'i lcags kyo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dus mtha'i 'gro ba bdag 'dra rnams la phan phyir/ mtsho sngon g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal zhes rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i nye 'gram/ twes mo bkra shis bde ster ma'i gnas su rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa yos lor/ nom chi mkhan ming pas sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/200

— legasaparabashad pa sa yi bstan bcos/༄7/ /sa'i bstan bcos lugs gnyis 'od brgya 'bar ba'i dbyig gi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dharma sur+ya/tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i 'jings gnas shing / /sku bzhi'i bde rim mngon par mtho /don gnyis zla nyi'i rna cha 'khrol/ /thub mchog sa 'dzin dbang pos skyongs/ /rnyed dka'i dal rten 'dzin ma'i gzhir/ /blo gros phun tshogs mtshan ma yi/ /ut+pal phreng ba rnam mdzes pa'i/ /gzhon nu gang dag mchid 'di gson/ /lugs zung blang dor tshul bzhin du/ /201

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/skyong la blo gros ldan pa'i mig /dgos pa rdul dang lcags phye dag /phye la khab len rdo dag bzhin/ /g.ya' yis bslad pa'i sa'i snying bo/ /sbyangs pas btso mar 'gyur ba bzhin/ /blo gros dman yang legs bshad kyi/ /thos pa che na mkhas par 'gyur/ /rnam dpyod shes rab che ldan pas/ /legs nyes 'byed kyi gzhan gyis min/ /dgos 'dod stsol ba'i nor bu las/ /rdo ba gzhan gyis ci byar yod/ /de phyir mkhas par 'dod pa dag /legs par bshad pa'i rin chen nor/ /che chung ci 'dra'ang bzung byas te/ /202

legs par bshad pa sa yi bstan bcos/yid rab mdzes pa'i phrar dgod bya/ /snod bcud mtshan ma ji snyed pa/ /sa chen 'di la brten pa bzhin/ /lugs zung bya ba'i tshogs mtha' dag /mthar son bsod nams rag las so/ /des na skyabs kyi phul gyur pa/ /mchog gsum bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal/ /spyi bo'i rgyan du legs btegs nas/ /mchod sogs bsod nams rgyu tshogs sgrubs/ /bya byed gang yang rtsad bcad cing / /ma dris don dag ma dpags par/ /lhur len mi rung rin chen nor/ /ma mthong nyo bar ci phyir nus/ /rang cag phal cher bzang ngan gyi/ /203

da legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ ྈgrogs kyi dbang las spyod tshul kun/ /ston pa tshon gyis kha bsgyur ba'i/ /shel rnams kha dog sna tshogs 'char/ /des na grogs kyi rnam dbye la/ /legs par dpyad de blang dor gyis/ /'jug ldog bya ba dngul chu yis/ /gser dang lcags phye 'byed pa bzhin/ /'phrad ma thag nas snying nye 'dra/ /ston kyang smra mang g.yo sgyu che/ /phrag dog gdug rtsub rgyud brlams grogs/ /rtug pa phyis pa'i rdo bzhin skyur/ /gang dag drang zhing sha tsha ldan/ /blo gros dkyel che yon tan dga'/ /rgyud dul ngang ring bzang po'i grogs/ /204

legs par bshad pa sa yi bstan bcos/gser ltar snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /bya gang thog mar rtsom pa'i tshe/ /sla bcos gzhan rjes rgyug min par/ /phugs don bsams te 'bad dgos pa/ /zhing pas so nams byed pa bzhin/ /rnam 'gyur 'dra yang phan gnod kyi/ / le lan ma 'dres so so ru/ /gzhal dgos bcos dang ma bcos gser/ /kha dog 'dra yang ngo bo min/ /rang rang phugs kyi don po che/ /snying du bzung ste kha sgo ru/ /dgos med mi 'byin snying nor dag /gang byung ston du mi rung bzhin/ /zhing pa rnams kyis lus ngag dag /205

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rdul du brlags te 'bad byed pa/ /de bzhin don chen sgrub pa'i tshe/ /ngal ba spangs te brtson pa dgos/ /'dod pa'i dngos po thog lhung tshe/ /cung zad skyon mthong g.yel mi bya/ /zong mchog mer sreg phangs gyur na/ /bzo yi rig byed ji ltar bya/ /shin tu dka' ba'i bya ba yang / /'bad pas bsgrubs na 'grub 'gyur te/ /gyong po'i lcags kyang bzhu btul gyis/ /sna tshogs zong du 'gyur ba mthong / /phyi tshul ngan yang nang nyid du/ /yon tan ci yod shes dka' bas/ /snang chung mi bya sa le sbram/ /206

legs par bshad pa sa yi bstan bcos/sa yi 'jings na gnas pa bzhin/ /'dod brnag khrel bor yid brtan med/ /gang dag phyi spyod legs gyur kyang / /'grogs na gad pa g.yang sa kha'i/ /ljon shing rgyas kyang myur du 'gyel/ /rang las dma' zhing nyam chung bar/ /brnyas smod tho co'i spyod pa dag /mi bya rdo ba chung ngu yis/ /bsnad nas srog dang bral ba mthong / /gzhan zer tshig ngag g.yo sgyu yis/ /bslad min ma brtags ma dpyad par/ /bgyis na nyams 'gyur gom gang gis/ /sa gsum shor ba'i gtam dag thos/ /phan gnod legs nyes mi dpyod par/ /207

da legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/lto 'grang tsam zhig don gnyer ba/ /kun gyis 'phya zhing mthar 'bud pa/ /ngan skyugs dor ba'i sa bzhin 'gyur/ /sa rul mang dag rmos byas kyang / /'bras bu 'byung bar mi 'gyur ltar/ /blo stobs brtson 'grus med pa yis/ /bya gang brtsams kyang don mi 'grub/ /gang zhig dgra bo mthong tsam gyis/ /rnam 'gyur sdang ba ston byed pa/ /byis pa sa la rtse ba bzhin/ /blo chung klad med ngang tshul ston/ /de bas dgra bo dag la yang / /kha mkhas thabs shes gang 'gab kyis/ /lan ldon lcags kyi pha bong yang /208

legs par bshad pa sa yi bstan bcos/zhu btul bgyis na gzhom par 'gyur/ /'on kyang skabs su bab gyur na/ /lag len snying khams mi chung ba/ /dgos pa brag ri gshogs pa'i phyir/ /rdzas ngan lag tu bstar dgos bzhin/ /gzhan du mtho dma' ci 'dra yang / /'phrad tshe khyad gsod sun 'byin sogs/ /bgyis na steng gnas pha bong dag /brus tshe rang mgor lhung bar 'gyur/ /rgyud gyong gshis ngan dman pa'i mir/ /lhag par btud na rengs gyur te/ /rdog pas brdzi 'gyur 'ug can gyi/ /sa la 'gre na gnod pa bzhin/ /khang khyim phub la brten gnas pa'i/ /209

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sa brten bca' dgos de bzhin du/ /don rnams sgrub la mkhas mdzangs pa'i / rje bo zhig la brten par bya/ /mkhas pa bsten na dge 'gyur te/ /ngan pa'i skyon las de lta min/ / bsam 'phel dbang las dgos 'dod 'byung / /dug can sa yis nyams par 'gyur/ /gdug can drin gyis bskyangs na yang / /mthar gyis drin lan gnod pa rtsom/ /byi ba sa la gnas gyur kyang / /sa rnams gtor bar byed la ltos/ /brag ri phyi nas bcom dka' yang / /khog nas 'byung ba'i chus 'jig sla/ /nad nyes bslus pas stobs ldan yang / /210

legs par bshad pa sa yi bstan bcos/yud kyis gzhom par gyur 'di mtshar/ /mkhas dang blo gros gzhung bzang pos/ /cung zad phan par bgyis gang la/ /de lan lhag ldon byed pa dag /sa zla'i mdangs bzhin je bzang 'gyur/ /blo ldan mkhas shing rang bzhin drang / /dag la don bcol gros dri bya/ /gzhan gyis ma yin gser dag dang / /sa gzhan mtshungs par ga la sgrub/ /nyam chung gyur kyang dgra yin na/ /bag zon bsten par bya dgos te/ /grog hral chung ngu rim mched pas/ /ri bo ral bar gyur la ltos/ /rang don khog bzung phyi tshul dag /211

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi shes zob kyi brdzu bag can/ /ra gan gser rtsis byugs pa yi/ /g.yo can dag la bag zon dgos/ /mdza' bshes nye du dag la yang / /ha cang rkam chags zhen na phung / /yid srub si tar chags pa yis/ /mgo bo sa la lhung zhes grags/ /rtag tu khro ba'i dbang song bas /gzhan la tshig ngan smra byas na/ /kun gyis mi bsten sa rong dag /rtsub mor su zhig mos pa byed/ /gzhan gyis bcol ba'i don dag la'ang / /'grub min brtags te khas blang bya/ /gzhan du 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'i/ /212

legs par bshadapa sa yi bstan bcos/zhing la so nams sus byed nus/ /nor rdzas chung ngu dag la yang / /phangs med chud bzos bya mi rung / / sa 'dzin dag kyang rdul phran rnams/ /rim gyis 'dus las byung ba bzhin/ / dgos don grub tshe ser sna yis/ /ma bcings lhug por gtong bar bya/ /rin chen khang bzang bkang na yang / /phan thogs ma gyur gzhan gyi nor/ /bsam mang grags 'dod shas che bas/ /bya ba sna tshogs rtsom byed pa/ /rang nyid nyams gzhi sa yi bdag /nga las nu dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /gzhan skyon mthong sla rang gi skyon/ /213

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mthong dka' sa 'og gter gnas bzhin/ /de phyir rang la legs brtags nas/ /skyon yon 'byed pa gnad du che/ /de ltar 'jig rten bya byed dag /myo nor spyad nas gtso bo ru/ /'di phyi'i don slad dam chos kyi/ /zhing sar 'bad pas so nams mdzod/ /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu dag /dngul dang brje ba su yis phod/ /gtan bde ster ba'i dal rten 'di/ /bde ba chung ngus g.yengs na phangs/ /sna lnga'i rin chen ji snyed dag /kun bzod gzhi las byung ba ltar/ /sa bcu lam lnga'i rtogs pa yang / /214

legs par bshad pa sa yi bstan bcos/dal rten bzang po 'di las grub/ /yongs 'du'i ljon pa'i shing dag gi /rtsa ba dbang chen gzhir gnas ltar/ /dam chos rin chen 'byung ba'i sgo/ /nyag gcig yi ge'i sbyor ba lags/ /de dag 'bri klog shes min pa/ /de la yon tan mi 'byung ste/ /sa gzhi med par ljon shing dang / /me tog la sogs ji ltar 'byung / /de phyir yi ge'i sbyor ba la/ /mkhas 'dod kun gyis ngal spangs te/ /'bad pa brtson bskyed btso sbyangs gser/ /bzhu btul dag la 'bad dgos bzhin/ /rgyus med sa gzhan zhugs pa'i tshe/ /215

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ sa mkhan dag la brten dgos ltar/ /chos kyi gnad don ma nor ba/ /ston pa'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten/ /gang du bgrod bya'i sa dag gi /sa/nas lugs ma 'dres dpyad dgos bzhin/ /chos tshul 'byed pa'i thos pa dag /ngoms med 'tshol la kun tu 'bad/ /chu yis non pa'i sa gang dag /myur du brdib par 'gyur ba ltar/ /tshe 'di nyid kyang yun ring du/ /mi sdod lnga ba'i lam du 'gro/ /lam gang zhugs tshe rkang ba yi/ /'degs 'jog re nas nyer 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin lo zla zhag gis drangs/ /2 16

legasaparabashadapagayibastanabacozi/rim song 'chi bdag nye bar 'gyur/ /nam zhig gshin rje'i pho nya yis/ /dbang med 'khrid tshe gang gis kyang / /phan par dka' ba sa chen dag /g.yo ba su yis 'dzin par nus/ /de tshe phan pa'i dngos po gang / /'dod dgu yid bzhin stsol ba'i gter/ /dam chos rin chen nor bu dag /kho na las gzhan dmigs su med/ /de phyir ltar snang bsre lhad kyi/ /g.ya' yis ma bcings dge ldan pa'i/ /lugs bzang chos tshul btso ma yi/ /gser sbyangs dag la brtun pa bskyed/ /phyi bshol le lo'i dbang gyur pas/ /217

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ bya gang phra mo'ang 'grub dka' na/ /gtan bde'i phan pa'ang sgrub byed pa'i/ / nor bu ci'i phyir lag tu lon/ /des na gzhon nu'i dus nyid nas/ /'du 'dzi spangs te dam chos la/ /gcig tu brtson pa ri dbang bzhin/ /nam yang g.yo ba med par bya/ /lang tsho yol tshe 'bad sems kyang / /'byung stobs dbang po nyams gyur pas/ /tshul bzhin mi 'grub rtsi ring sar/ /so nam byed par dka' ba bzhin/ / 'jig rten pha rol bgrod pa'i tshe/ /nag po'i las mtha' phyir 'brangs nas/ /dpag tshad du ma'i g.yang sa cher/ /218

legasruparabashadapa sa yi bstan bcos/lhung ste ngan song sdug bsngal myong / / rab 'bar me lce'i phreng ba yis/ /phyogs bzhir khebs pa'i nang nyid du/ /skyes te lcags bsregs sa gzhi la/ /'drud cing bsregs pas gdung bar 'gyur/ /'ga' zhig grang reg mi bzad pas/ /rdo ba dag kyang gas gyur pa'i/ /'khyag rom gnas su sha rus dag /so sor 'byed pa'i tshor ba myong / /la la gling dbar sa yi steng / /nyi mtshan bde sdug re mos sogs/ /nyi tshe'i dmyal bas sdug bsngal tshul/ /sngon gyi byung ba las 'byung bzhin/ /lo ni du ma'i bar dag tu/ /219

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kha zas rdul phran tsam la yang /spyod pa'i skabs bral bkres skom gyi/ /gdung bas gzir ba'i ngang tshul soms/ /ljan ljin sa 'og mi gtsang khrod/ /nyam ngar gcig la gcig za zhing / /bkol spyod brdeg sogs sna tshogs kyis/ /gtses pa'i dud 'gro ji ltar bzod/ /de lta'i ngan song mi bzad pa'i/ /duḥkha'i tshogs las skyob pa dag /sa gsum lus med 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /rin chen rnam pa gsum du nges/ /chu klung 'dzoms pa'i zhing sar yang /sa bon ma btab skye mi rung / /de phyir yid ches mos gus kyi/ /220

legs par bshad pa sa yi bstan bcos/rgyu tshogs ma 'bad skyob par dka'/ /des na legs byas rnam dkar gyi/ /myu gu'i tshogs rnams dad pa'i stobs/ /gsol 'debs drod gsher gyis bskyangs na/ /mngon mtho nges legs 'bras smin 'gyur/ /sa steng sa blar gnas pa yi/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs kyang / /skye rga na 'chi'i rdul dag gis/ /gos par 'gyur las gzhan du ci/ /srid 'byor dpal yon la zhen pa/ /sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba/ /sa yi sbrang rtsi spyod ches pas/ /zug rngus gtses pa'i tshul dag thos/ /srid rtse nas bzung mnar med bar/ /221

— legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sa gsum yangs pa'i khyon dag la/ /dbang med rgyu zhing 'khor byed pa'i/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis gnas lugs sgoms/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i sa gang dag /nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas su rig nas/ /thar pa'i mkha' dbyings bgrod pa yi/ /lam mchog sgrub la brtun pa bskyed/ /thog med dus nas drin bskyangs pa'i/ /mar gyur 'gro rnams sdug bsngal gyis/ /sa 'og mun par gnas dag la/ /snying rje'i sgron me sbar bar bya /rang bde tsam zhig dud 'gro la'ang / /yod phyir des chog mi bya bar/ /nges legs 'grub pa'i sa yi rten/ /222

legs par bshad pa sa yi bstan bcos/bdag gzhan mnyam brjer nyams len zungs/ /mi gtsang lus kyi sa yi khams/ /sku gsum rin chen zong mchog tu/ /sgyur byed gser sgyur rtsi yi mchog /byang chub sems la nan tan mdzod/ /nor rdzas sgyu ma'i phung po la/ /ser sna'i mdud pas ma bcings par/ /rin chen rnam bzhi'i sbyin pa yis/ /dbul phongs yongs la gter kha spel/ /gang dag mngon mtho nges legs kyi/ /phun tshogs ji snyed 'byung ba'i gzhi//tshul khrims gtsang ma'i zhing sa la/ /gtan du bde ba'i so nams mdzod/ /rdeg 'cha' tshig rtsub mi bzad pa'i/ /223

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mtshon cha 'bar ba rab bsnun kyang / /bzod pa'i lcags kyi ra ba yis/ /kun gzhi'i sa khang bsrung bar bya/ /le lo g.yeng ba'i rkun po yis/ /dge ba'i nor mchog khyer gyi dogs/ /brtson 'grus lcags sgrog 'khyud mo yis/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams yongs su sdoms/ /dge ba'i dmigs pa gang la yang / /gtad na gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i/ /ting 'dzin ri yi dbang po la /g.yo med dran pas dam du zungs/ /gnyis snang spros pa kun bral ba'i/ /bden med ye shes thog mda' yis//ngar 'dzin 'jig lta'i ri bo dag /224

legs par bshad pa sa yi bstan bcos/phye mar brlag pa'i thabs la 'bod/ / rmi lam bden par grub min yang / /bde sdug mtshan ma ston pa ltar/ /stong pa'i zhing sa rten 'byung gi /lo 'bras smin pa'i tshul dag gzigs/ /thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ /rnam dag dbang gi gzhir gnas pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa'i ka ba dag /brtan po sgrub pa'i thabs la brtson/ /snod bcud 'dzin ma'i khyon yangs por /tha mal zhen pa rab bkag ste/ /gang snang 'khor lor 'char byed pa'i/ /bskyed rim rnal 'byor mchog la brtson/ /chos dbyings rnam dag rtsig pa'i ngos/ /225

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ —mtshan dpe'i tshon ris bkra ba'i sku/ /ting 'dzin pir gyis nyer sgrub pas/ /zung 'jug sgrub la gcig tu brtson/ /de nas sprul sgyur sna tshogs pas/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhir gnas pa'i/ /yid can mtha' dag kun mkhyen gyi/ / ye shes sa la 'god par smon/ /lugs gnyis 'od brgya 'bar ba yi/ /legs bshad dbyig gi phreng ba 'di/ /dam pa rnams la 'os min yang / /blo gsar rgyan du phan snyam bris/ /'di yi dge tshogs bsam 'phel dbang / /'dod pa 'jo ba de yi mthus/ /dri med rgyal bstan 'dzin ma'i gzhir/ /226
